Our 90-year heritage gives us distinct perspective on the needs of patients and caregivers. We lead
today by putting those insights to work to deliver new, better healthcare solutions and access to
care in the communities where we live and work.

  Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet the needs of all our

  governance.

  We strive to create lasting value by delivering sustainable healthcare, advancing climate and

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

# We are Committed to Life

[More][106]
[

### Vision

We strive to transform Fresenius Kabi in the decade to come. We are committed to increase
efficiencies in the therapy and care of patients and improve access to high-quality healthcare
around the globe.

[healthcare professionals in action]
][107]
[

### Excellence

We are specialized in lifesaving medicines and technologies for critically and chronically ill
patients. With our passion and expertise, we touch the lives of almost 450 million people every
year, each one representing the importance of our work.

[healthcare professionals in action]
][108]
[

### Sustainability

We constantly strive to improve our sustainability footprint. For us, meeting the needs of patients
and healthcare professionals goes hand in hand with responsible and ethical management.

[nurse taking hand of woman]
][109]
[

### Think Beyond: Latest Evidence for Effective Therapies in CKD

Join experts at the Global Renal Nutrition Webinar on June 16, 2026. Explore ERA 2026 insights,
protein‑reduced diets, and targeted CKD nutrition.
[Global Kidney Nutrition Webinar Key Visual]
][110]
[

### Women Who Shaped Us

At Fresenius Kabi, colleagues worldwide share personal stories for International Women’s Day,
honoring the women who shaped their courage and purpose.
[Images of Fresenius Kabi employees being interviewed on international womens day.]
][111]
[

### Fresenius Kabi recognized as a Top Employer in 13 countries

Fresenius Kabi has been certified by Top Employers Institute as a Top Employer for 2026 in 13
countries and additionally two regions.
[Image showing the top employer 2026 seals of the 13 countries and 2 regions.]
][112]
[

### Four Colleagues, Four Scientific Journeys: Voices of Women in Science

Female scientists from Biopharma, MedTech, Nutrition and Pharma share their stories and advice,
showing how science careers impact patient care and innovation.
[Image of women in science.]
][113]
[

### Meet The Heroes Behind Patient Safety

Unseen heroes ensure patient safety through precision, care, and smart tech at Fresenius Kabi.
Discover how people make the difference.
[Several people in different job roles like production and lab workers depicted as heroes with capes
and gadgets.]

### Vision

We strive to transform Fresenius Kabi in the decade to come. We are committed to increase
efficiencies in the therapy and care of patients and improve access to high-quality healthcare
around the globe.

# Innovation

## Innovation means more moments like this

We're driven by our deep understanding of the root causes of disease, focusing our R&D in areas like
cancer, HIV, and respiratory diseases where we can make the most meaningful difference for people.

[Discover more about our R&D approach][205]
[Close video][206]

## Who we are

As a focused biopharma company, we discover, develop and deliver medicines and vaccines to create
value for patients and shareholders. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by
the end of the decade.

Our R&D focus is on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV;
and infectious diseases.

# Better health. Within reach. Every day.

As a global pharmaceutical company, at Hikma we are creating high-quality products and making them
accessible to those who need them, helping to shape a healthier world that enriches all our
communities.

[ Who we are ][82]
Play video
Transcript

**SR 2025 VIDEO**

I am pleased to announce the publication of our 2025 sustainability report. This report highlights
our Sustainability Approach and , and our commitment to Acting Responsibly. For 50 years we've
focused on producing high-quality medicines and contributing to a healthy society. Our aim is to put
better health within reach every day. 

Our approach to sustainability rests on four key pillars, at the center, our core pillar of
advancing health and wellbeing, and in support are our three pillars on empowering our people,
protecting the environment, and operating transparently and ethically. 

In 2025, we created a clear  and coherent access to medicine strategy and introduced a set of
metrics through which we can measure and benchmark our performance. 

Globally, we were able to treat more than 222 million patients, which demonstrates the true impact
of our efforts. 2025 also saw continued work with our communities by providing educational
opportunities, food donations and offering medicines to those most in need. And in total we donated
medicines worth more than $2.6m. Community engagement and social responsibility is something that is
ingrained in our culture, over the course of the year we reached more than 560,000 people through
our community outreach programmes. 

We also continued to support out people. Our recently completed People Voice Survey showed employee
engagement at 73% and employee enablement at 68%. The results will help guide our employee
programmes and help continue to make Hikma a great place to work.

As a global pharmaceutical company, at Hikma we are creating high-quality products and making them
accessible to those who need them, helping to shape a healthier world that enriches all our
communities.

[ Who we are ][82]
Play video
Transcript

**SR 2025 VIDEO**

I am pleased to announce the publication of our 2025 sustainability report. This report highlights
our Sustainability Approach and , and our commitment to Acting Responsibly. For 50 years we've
focused on producing high-quality medicines and contributing to a healthy society. Our aim is to put
better health within reach every day. 

Our approach to sustainability rests on four key pillars, at the center, our core pillar of
advancing health and wellbeing, and in support are our three pillars on empowering our people,
protecting the environment, and operating transparently and ethically. 

In 2025, we created a clear  and coherent access to medicine strategy and introduced a set of
metrics through which we can measure and benchmark our performance. 

Globally, we were able to treat more than 222 million patients, which demonstrates the true impact
of our efforts. 2025 also saw continued work with our communities by providing educational
opportunities, food donations and offering medicines to those most in need. And in total we donated
medicines worth more than $2.6m. Community engagement and social responsibility is something that is
ingrained in our culture, over the course of the year we reached more than 560,000 people through
our community outreach programmes. 

We also continued to support out people. Our recently completed People Voice Survey showed employee
engagement at 73% and employee enablement at 68%. The results will help guide our employee
programmes and help continue to make Hikma a great place to work. 

Throughout 2025, we continued to improve  our environmental performance, focusing specifically on
mitigating our emissions and establishing a more robust approach to water management, particularly
in the water scarce countries where we operate. As an example, we established water stewardship and
absolute CO2 emission reduction KPIs that link directly to Executive remuneration.

We also opened a new 1MW solar park in Jordan, and have plans to go much further in the coming
years.

Finally, we also spent 2025 continuing to focus on ethics and transparency across our value chain,
and taking serious measures to safeguard fundamental human rights both in the upstream and
downstream parts of our business. 

This year, for the first time we asked our key suppliers to rate us on how well we work with them,
and how we uphold our own Code of Conduct.

We believe that our high-quality medicines should reach everyone who needs them . This is why we
focus on acting responsibly, that means advancing health and wellbeing, empowering our people,
protecting the environment, and operating transparently and ethically.

# Better health. Within reach. Every day.

As a global pharmaceutical company, at Hikma we are creating high-quality products and making them
accessible to those who need them, helping to shape a healthier world that enriches all our
communities.

[ Who we are ][82]
Play video
Transcript

**SR 2025 VIDEO**

I am pleased to announce the publication of our 2025 sustainability report. This report highlights
our Sustainability Approach and , and our commitment to Acting Responsibly. For 50 years we've
focused on producing high-quality medicines and contributing to a healthy society. Our aim is to put
better health within reach every day. 

Our approach to sustainability rests on four key pillars, at the center, our core pillar of
advancing health and wellbeing, and in support are our three pillars on empowering our people,
protecting the environment, and operating transparently and ethically. 

In 2025, we created a clear  and coherent access to medicine strategy and introduced a set of
metrics through which we can measure and benchmark our performance. 

Globally, we were able to treat more than 222 million patients, which demonstrates the true impact
of our efforts. 2025 also saw continued work with our communities by providing educational
opportunities, food donations and offering medicines to those most in need. And in total we donated
medicines worth more than $2.6m. Community engagement and social responsibility is something that is
ingrained in our culture, over the course of the year we reached more than 560,000 people through
our community outreach programmes. 

We also continued to support out people. Our recently completed People Voice Survey showed employee
engagement at 73% and employee enablement at 68%. The results will help guide our employee
programmes and help continue to make Hikma a great place to work. 

Throughout 2025, we continued to improve  our environmental performance, focusing specifically on
mitigating our emissions and establishing a more robust approach to water management, particularly
in the water scarce countries where we operate. As an example, we established water stewardship and
absolute CO2 emission reduction KPIs that link directly to Executive remuneration.

We also opened a new 1MW solar park in Jordan, and have plans to go much further in the coming
years.

Finally, we also spent 2025 continuing to focus on ethics and transparency across our value chain,
and taking serious measures to safeguard fundamental human rights both in the upstream and
downstream parts of our business. 

This year, for the first time we asked our key suppliers to rate us on how well we work with them,
and how we uphold our own Code of Conduct.

We believe that our high-quality medicines should reach everyone who needs them . This is why we
focus on acting responsibly, that means advancing health and wellbeing, empowering our people,
protecting the environment, and operating transparently and ethically.

# Introducing
# Keenova and Par Health

On July 31, 2025, Mallinckrodt and Endo joined together to better serve patients and customers with
a bold plan for the future. Following the merger, the combined company then spun off its generics
and sterile injectables business as an independent company—Par Health—and rebranded the specialty
therapeutics company as Keenova Therapeutics in November 2025. 

Today, Keenova and Par Health operate as separate companies, each with its own mission and identity.
Please select the one you would like to visit.

Keenova strives to help patients with rare, stigmatized, or unaddressed conditions live happier and
healthier lives. Our areas of focus include, among others, immunology, urology, hepatology,
ophthalmology, orthopedics, and critical care.

[ Keenova.com ][6]

Par Health is the essential pharmaceutical company. We develop high-quality generics, sterile
injectables, and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), supported by a robust, U.S.-advantaged
manufacturing network. With over 4,000 team members worldwide, we believe great healthcare is built
on getting the essentials right.

# Introducing
# Keenova and Par Health

On July 31, 2025, Mallinckrodt and Endo joined together to better serve patients and customers with
a bold plan for the future. Following the merger, the combined company then spun off its generics
and sterile injectables business as an independent company—Par Health—and rebranded the specialty
therapeutics company as Keenova Therapeutics in November 2025. 

Today, Keenova and Par Health operate as separate companies, each with its own mission and identity.
Please select the one you would like to visit.

Keenova strives to help patients with rare, stigmatized, or unaddressed conditions live happier and
healthier lives. Our areas of focus include, among others, immunology, urology, hepatology,
ophthalmology, orthopedics, and critical care.

[ Keenova.com ][6]

Par Health is the essential pharmaceutical company. We develop high-quality generics, sterile
injectables, and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), supported by a robust, U.S.-advantaged
manufacturing network. With over 4,000 team members worldwide, we believe great healthcare is built
on getting the essentials right.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Answers to common questions about Veterinary APIs, Human APIs, bulk supply, exports, and contract
manufacturing.

Who is the leading Veterinary API manufacturer in India?

Aarambh Life Science is a GMP-certified Veterinary API manufacturer in India, supplying high-quality
active pharmaceutical ingredients for animal healthcare applications worldwide.

Do you manufacture both Veterinary APIs and Human APIs?

Yes, Aarambh Life Science manufactures and supplies a wide range of Veterinary APIs and Human APIs
for pharmaceutical companies globally.

How do I choose a reliable API manufacturer in India?

When selecting an API manufacturer, consider GMP compliance, product quality, manufacturing
capabilities, regulatory standards, documentation support, and supply reliability. Aarambh Life
Science follows stringent quality practices and provides reliable API supply solutions for
pharmaceutical companies.

Is Aarambh Life Science a GMP-certified API manufacturer?

Yes, we follow GMP-compliant manufacturing processes and stringent quality standards to ensure
product safety and consistency.

Do you export APIs internationally?

Yes, we export Veterinary APIs and Human APIs to pharmaceutical companies, distributors, and
healthcare organizations across international markets.

Why source Veterinary and Human APIs from India?

India is a global hub for pharmaceutical manufacturing, offering high-quality APIs, GMP-compliant
production facilities, skilled expertise, and cost-effective supply solutions. Aarambh Life Science
supplies Veterinary APIs and Human APIs to domestic and international markets.

What quality documents are available with your APIs?

We provide relevant documentation including COA, specifications, and other quality-related documents
based on customer requirements.

How can I request a quotation for APIs?

You can contact our team through the inquiry form or Contact Us page to receive a customized
quotation for your API requirements.

# Welcome to Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.

**“For The Healthier Humankind”**

The definition of Actiza is “**Active zeal**”. We have an active zeal for a healthier world. Actiza
Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. has become a paradigm in pharmaceutical manufacturing, exporting, and
supplying products that meet international standards. Actiza believes in a systematic approach to
all its endeavours. Hence, we have **WHO, GMP, and ISO accreditations** for our business. India has
been a hub for medical tourism, and now it has become an epicentre for pharmaceutical manufacturing,
alongside the world’s medicinal exporter and supplier of all medicines to create a world that is

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

As a global CDMO headquartered in Munich, Germany, we are committed to fulfilling the pharmaceutical
needs of clients throughout Europe, Japan and North America. Our approach is rooted in a
customer-centric philosophy that guarantees exceptional quality and service in every aspect.

We are a reliable CDMO partner, providing comprehensive Development and Manufacturing services for
drug products, from small molecules to large molecules. We offer end-to-end services for your small
molecule finished dosage forms (FDFs), including sterile and non-sterile liquids, solids, and
semi-solids products, and we are also specialised in biologicals, orphan drugs, clinical trials,
fill-and-finish, and lyophilisation.

### Athens, Greece

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of
Value Added Medicines and has been recently upgraded with HPAPI capabilities.

⟶][121]
[[flag][flag]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.  

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

⟶][125]
[[flag][flag]

### Leipzig, Germany

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

⟶][126]
[[flag][flag]

### Maisons-Alfort, France

At our facility in France, we manufacture sterile prefilled syringes and liquid or lyophilised
vials.
With high-speed aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and integrated packaging, the site uses
GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

[[flag][flag]

### Athens, Greece

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of
Value Added Medicines and has been recently upgraded with HPAPI capabilities.

⟶][121]
[[flag][flag]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.  

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

⟶][125]
[[flag][flag]

### Leipzig, Germany

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

⟶][126]
[[flag][flag]

### Maisons-Alfort, France

At our facility in France, we manufacture sterile prefilled syringes and liquid or lyophilised
vials.
With high-speed aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and integrated packaging, the site uses
GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

Welcome To Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd.

We deliver affordable and quality medicines across the world, regardless of geographic and
socio-economic barriers. This aptitude of ours can be credited to our successful portfolio of
businesses.

Through our efficient manufacturing services backed with highly qualified technical team, we
endeavor to build blocks to produce an organization that manufactures therapeutics for a variety of
diseases.

[Click here to][22] Download Our Brochure!

### Our Mission

We strive for a happier, healthier tomorrow. We shall be working on total customer satisfaction and
achieve leadership in pharmaceutical marketplace, products and services across the globe, through
excellence in technology, based on research and development , compliance with regulatory
requirements and expectation in an effective and efficient manner. Our human resources will continue
to be the most valuable asset in this pursuit of leadership and the prime driving forces for our
growth. We are responsible to society. We shall be good corporate citizens and will be driven by
high ethical standardizing our practices.

### Our Vision

Our vision is to be leading pharmaceutical company in India and become a significant global player.
Our aim is to be a global player, will lead to the establishment of operation in the key markets of
the world including the developing countries. We apply to enrich our people – our driving force, to
become highly competent professional and technology based.

Why Choose Us

Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. is a young & emerging global pharmaceutical manufacturing &
marketing company. We manufacture & market a broad range of Pharmaceutical finished formulations.

In the year 2000, Mr. Jitendra Prasad, a young Engineering graduate having pharmaceutical project
background, had established Akriti Export Agencies. In very short span of time he had given a
profitable shape of business to Akriti Export Agencies because of his hard work and very positive
mental attitude. Our activities range from manufacturing & marketing of finished pharmaceutical
formulations of Niche therapeutic segments. Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. has its headquarter in
Thane suburb of Mumbai, the financial capital of India .

Akriti Pharmaceuticals has operation in ** CIS Countries** and now expanding its wings to
**European, South East Asian, Latin American, Middle East & African countries**.

Our manufacturing unit has been approved with various International certifications and follows the
laid down norms of FDA India, CGMP under Schedule 'M' as well as it is **WHO-GMP **certified.

## Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Ltd.: Leading the Way in Pharma Manufacturing

▼

Akums Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Ltd. stands as India’s largest and most trusted Contract Development
and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), redefining pharmaceutical excellence through innovation,
quality, and efficiency. As a preferred partner for leading pharmaceutical and healthcare companies
worldwide, Akums is committed to delivering groundbreaking formulations that meet evolving market
needs.

With 15+ state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, Akums offers unmatched expertise across diverse
therapeutic segments and dosage forms, including tablets, capsules, injectables, soft gels, syrups,
topicals, nutraceuticals, cosmeceuticals, derma solutions etc. Our robust R&D capabilities drive
innovation, ensuring fast, cost-effective product development that aligns with stringent regulatory
standards.

Akums is also a trusted leader in Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) manufacturing, ensuring a
seamless and high-quality supply of essential raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations. Our API
capabilities are in compliance with international regulatory standards, supporting the development
of superior formulations while enhancing supply chain reliability for our partners.

Quality at Akums is more than a benchmark—it is a culture. We adhere to global regulatory standards,
including WHO-GMP, USFDA, EU-GMP, and TGA, ensuring that every product meets the highest safety and
efficacy standards. Our advanced Quality Management System (QMS) and compliance-driven approach
reinforce our leadership in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

Akums collaborates with 1500+ pharmaceutical companies, manufacturing over 4100+ commercialized
formulations. Our expertise extends beyond manufacturing to include formulation development,
technology transfers, regulatory support, and customized solutions, helping brands expand their
portfolios and market presence seamlessly.

While innovation fuels our growth, sustainability shapes our future. Akums integrates eco-friendly
initiatives and energy-efficient manufacturing processes, ensuring responsible business operations
that contribute to a healthier planet.

Leading the Make in India initiative, Akums continues to revolutionize global healthcare by
providing high-quality, innovative pharmaceutical solutions with a patient-first approach,
strengthening its position as a driving force in the industry.

## Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Ltd.: Leading the Way in Pharma Manufacturing

▼

Akums Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Ltd. stands as India’s largest and most trusted Contract Development
and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), redefining pharmaceutical excellence through innovation,
quality, and efficiency. As a preferred partner for leading pharmaceutical and healthcare companies
worldwide, Akums is committed to delivering groundbreaking formulations that meet evolving market
needs.

With 15+ state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, Akums offers unmatched expertise across diverse
therapeutic segments and dosage forms, including tablets, capsules, injectables, soft gels, syrups,
topicals, nutraceuticals, cosmeceuticals, derma solutions etc. Our robust R&D capabilities drive
innovation, ensuring fast, cost-effective product development that aligns with stringent regulatory
standards.

Akums is also a trusted leader in Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) manufacturing, ensuring a
seamless and high-quality supply of essential raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations. Our API
capabilities are in compliance with international regulatory standards, supporting the development
of superior formulations while enhancing supply chain reliability for our partners.

Quality at Akums is more than a benchmark—it is a culture. We adhere to global regulatory standards,
including WHO-GMP, USFDA, EU-GMP, and TGA, ensuring that every product meets the highest safety and
efficacy standards. Our advanced Quality Management System (QMS) and compliance-driven approach
reinforce our leadership in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

Akums collaborates with 1500+ pharmaceutical companies, manufacturing over 4100+ commercialized
formulations. Our expertise extends beyond manufacturing to include formulation development,
technology transfers, regulatory support, and customized solutions, helping brands expand their
portfolios and market presence seamlessly.

While innovation fuels our growth, sustainability shapes our future. Akums integrates eco-friendly
initiatives and energy-efficient manufacturing processes, ensuring responsible business operations
that contribute to a healthier planet.

Leading the Make in India initiative, Akums continues to revolutionize global healthcare by
providing high-quality, innovative pharmaceutical solutions with a patient-first approach,
strengthening its position as a driving force in the industry.

1907
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey beginning in 1907]

1940
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1940]

Began production of cough syrups, vitamins, tonics and sulphur drugs

1961
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1961]

Inaugurated Penicilin plant with Lal Bahadur Shastri in attendance

1967
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1967]

Initiated bulk manufacturing of Vitamin B12

1971
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1971]

Manufactured Erythromycin for the first time in Indian history

1972
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1972]

Launched Althrocin, a brand of Erythromycin

1997
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1997]

Althrocin moves to become top selling brand in India

1999

Kickstarted the production of synthetic, organic API

2000

Received ISO 14000 certification for facilities at Vadodara

2001
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2001]

Began production of Cephalosporin C

2007
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2007]

Acquired non-oncology business of M/s Dabur Pharma Ltd.

2009
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2009]

Addressed chronic therapies through multiple marketing divisions

2011
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2011]

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

2012
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2012]

Unveiled the Dematology division in domestic market with 8 products

2013
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2013]

Started first NDA with a partner and commenced filing in EU, Australia and Brazil

2015
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2015]

Launched Aripiprazole and established the US Front-end as also transitioning to in-house marketing
in the US

2016
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2016]

Struck a JV with Orbicular – Aleor Dermaceutical Limited to develop dermatology products for the
international market

2017

[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Inaugurated the manufacturing facility for Oncology medicines, including oral solids and liquid
injectable vials, in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri. Vijay Rupani

2017
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Acquired Orit Laboratories LLC, USA

2018
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2018]

Received FDA approvals for Aleor’s dermatology facility

2019
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2019]

Granted approvals for Oncology oral solid facility

Entered a JV to foray into the China market

2020
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2020]

Achieved the milestone of US$ 250 million sales in the US frontend

#### A Day in the Life of a Veterinary Scientist, Ophthalmology

Marianna Bacellar-Galdino has always loved scientific research, and after a particularly eye-opening
project in veterinary school, ophthalmology became the thread connecting all her scientific
interests—and eventually her whole career.

[Watch now! ][19]

We are a forward-thinking, mid-size early phase contract research organization, in Canada and the
U.S., offering biopharmaceutical companies of all sizes a proven, flexible approach to early drug
development, including preclinical safety testing, clinical pharmacology (Phase I to Phase II),
bioanalysis (preclinical to Phase IV), research services, and manufacturing and analytical services.

Focused on your success … always available and always looking ahead ... moving in unison to deliver
big impact with a personal touch.

## WHAT WE DO

We help you reach early phase drug development decision-making milestones sooner, improving speed
and ease from lead candidate selection to proof of concept, and beyond.

Energy Security Framework Gas Prices Explained Permitting Reform American Energy Snapshot

### **AMERICAN ENERGY SECURITY FRAMEWORK**

Recent geopolitical disruptions and their impact on global energy markets have been a stark reminder
that energy security remains inseparable from economic security and geopolitical stability. The
United States is better positioned than most nations to navigate market volatility, thanks to
decades of investment and innovation that made America the world's leading producer of oil and
natural gas and a reliable supplier to global markets. But future disruptions will require a
stronger, more flexible energy system—one built on secure supply, modern infrastructure and
resilience.

The following recommendations provide a framework for getting there.

SECURE AMERICAN ENERGY SUPPLY
* Develop a Robust Federal Offshore Leasing Program
* Ensure Stable, Consistent Fuel Supply Through a Functional Renewable Fuel Standard
* Optimize the Strategic Petroleum Reserve

BUILD INFRASTRUCTURE AND MOVE ENERGY
* Pass Comprehensive Permitting Reform
* Improve the Jones Act to Unlock Domestic Energy Flexibility
* Provide Relief from Unnecessary Tariffs on Critical Energy Inputs

STRENGTHEN RESILIENCE AND SUPPLY CHAINS
* Work with Persian Gulf Allies to Reduce Reliance on the Strait of Hormuz
* Strengthen Western Hemisphere Energy Security

[Learn More][36]
[Download The Framework][37]
[AMERICAN ENERGY SECURITY FRAMEWORK]

Gas prices get a lot of attention, but they’re driven by a complex set of global factors, with crude
oil markets playing the central role. This explainer puts those dynamics into context and breaks
down what’s behind the numbers at the pump.

[Gas Prices Explained]

### **America Builds. America wins.**

Building new infrastructure allows energy to flow faster and more easily which could make energy
more affordable for consumers.

[Learn More][39]

### **AMERICAN ENERGY SECURITY FRAMEWORK**

Recent geopolitical disruptions and their impact on global energy markets have been a stark reminder
that energy security remains inseparable from economic security and geopolitical stability. The
United States is better positioned than most nations to navigate market volatility, thanks to
decades of investment and innovation that made America the world's leading producer of oil and
natural gas and a reliable supplier to global markets. But future disruptions will require a
stronger, more flexible energy system—one built on secure supply, modern infrastructure and
resilience.

The following recommendations provide a framework for getting there.

SECURE AMERICAN ENERGY SUPPLY
* Develop a Robust Federal Offshore Leasing Program
* Ensure Stable, Consistent Fuel Supply Through a Functional Renewable Fuel Standard
* Optimize the Strategic Petroleum Reserve

BUILD INFRASTRUCTURE AND MOVE ENERGY
* Pass Comprehensive Permitting Reform
* Improve the Jones Act to Unlock Domestic Energy Flexibility
* Provide Relief from Unnecessary Tariffs on Critical Energy Inputs

STRENGTHEN RESILIENCE AND SUPPLY CHAINS
* Work with Persian Gulf Allies to Reduce Reliance on the Strait of Hormuz
* Strengthen Western Hemisphere Energy Security

[Learn More][36]

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

[GET IN TOUCH][93]

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

# Tailored pharmacokinetics, enhanced safety.

Reimagine what’s possible.

**WE ARE ARx.** Your drug delivery partner for what’s next.

Achieve next-generation absorption, precision and control while keeping the patient experience front
and center, with ARx. Your established partner in oral thin film and transdermal delivery systems.

[ Partner With Us ][49]

### Therapeutic Thin Film

Our oral thin films provide a convenient, easy-to-use platform for fast-acting, immediate-release
therapies that bypass first-pass metabolism. These dissolvable strips deliver medication directly
into the bloodstream through the oral mucosa, ensuring faster absorption, fewer side effects and a
more comfortable patient experience.
* Quick and precise drug delivery.
* Convenient design that eliminates swallowing difficulties.
* Customizable profiles for tailored therapeutic experiences.
* Improved bioavailability.
* Taste-masking options in various flavors.
* Easy transport and discreet administration.

[ Dosage Forms ][50]

### Transdermal Patches

Our transdermal patches deliver medication through a controlled-release system that penetrates the
skin and directly enters the bloodstream. By bypassing the digestive system and liver, they maintain
consistent drug levels, reducing the need for frequent doses and minimizing side effects.
* Non-invasive application for ease of use.
* Controlled release for consistent therapeutic levels.
* Avoidance of side effects from peaks and troughs of serum levels.
* Versatile options tailored for localized or systemic needs.
* Long-lasting wear reduces the frequency of dosing.
* Avoids first-pass metabolism and potential for GI side effects.

[ Dosage Forms ][51]

## Technologies

Our innovative technology platforms are designed to deliver better absorption and bioavailability
while improving the experience for patients.
**This includes MicroDEP, our breakthrough, patented method for rapid-onset delivery of ultra-low
doses through an oral thin film. **
* Precise dosing with as little as five micrograms.
* Fast absorption for quick onset of effects.
* Micro-sized deposits for targeted delivery.
* Enhanced bioavailability bypasses the digestive system.
* Customizable formulations for various APIs and needs.

ARx specializes in developing novel, innovative drug delivery systems that improve control of drug
release and absorption, bioavailability, as well as patient experience and safety, expanding

film and adhesive polymer science and novel dosing strategies, we’ve helped shape modern drug
delivery through higher standards for quality, safety and efficacy.

ensure they meet product specifications and the highest clinical standards.

## Therapeutic Areas

Patients with complex conditions need drug delivery systems that are precise, customized, and
adaptable. Standard methods often fail to provide consistent dosing, improved absorption, and
sustained effects. ARx designs tailored delivery systems that improve drug bioavailability while
avoiding first-pass metabolism and accommodating complex conditions to improve patient quality of
life.

Our solutions cover the following therapeutic areas:
* Parkinson's
* Alzheimer’s
* Cancer
* Opioid Addiction
* Chronic Pain
* Obesity

### Parkinson's Disease

Controlled-release systems provide reliable, consistent dosing, helping patients manage Parkinson's
disease more effectively while supporting better adherence and quality of life.

### Alzheimer’s Disease

Alternative delivery methods ensure steady absorption and consistent dosing, supporting long-term
management of Alzheimer’s disease and cognitive function.

### Cancer

Controlled, consistent drug delivery reduces dosing frequency and side effects, improving comfort
for cancer patients throughout treatment.

### Opioid Addiction

Alternative dosing systems enhance adherence and provide steady medication delivery, supporting
recovery and reducing the risk of relapse.

### Chronic Pain

Transdermal patches and oral thin films provide reliable pain relief, reducing dosing frequency and
minimizing side effects, making chronic pain management more manageable.

### Obesity

Oral thin films and transdermal patches offer discreet, easy-to-use delivery options, helping
patients with obesity manage their treatment and improve adherence.

[ Partner With Us ][49]

### Therapeutic Thin Film

Our oral thin films provide a convenient, easy-to-use platform for fast-acting, immediate-release
therapies that bypass first-pass metabolism. These dissolvable strips deliver medication directly
into the bloodstream through the oral mucosa, ensuring faster absorption, fewer side effects and a
more comfortable patient experience.
* Quick and precise drug delivery.
* Convenient design that eliminates swallowing difficulties.
* Customizable profiles for tailored therapeutic experiences.
* Improved bioavailability.
* Taste-masking options in various flavors.
* Easy transport and discreet administration.

[ Dosage Forms ][50]

### Transdermal Patches

Our transdermal patches deliver medication through a controlled-release system that penetrates the
skin and directly enters the bloodstream. By bypassing the digestive system and liver, they maintain
consistent drug levels, reducing the need for frequent doses and minimizing side effects.
* Non-invasive application for ease of use.
* Controlled release for consistent therapeutic levels.
* Avoidance of side effects from peaks and troughs of serum levels.
* Versatile options tailored for localized or systemic needs.
* Long-lasting wear reduces the frequency of dosing.
* Avoids first-pass metabolism and potential for GI side effects.

[ Dosage Forms ][51]

## Technologies

Our innovative technology platforms are designed to deliver better absorption and bioavailability
while improving the experience for patients.
**This includes MicroDEP, our breakthrough, patented method for rapid-onset delivery of ultra-low
doses through an oral thin film. **
* Precise dosing with as little as five micrograms.
* Fast absorption for quick onset of effects.
* Micro-sized deposits for targeted delivery.
* Enhanced bioavailability bypasses the digestive system.
* Customizable formulations for various APIs and needs.

[ View MicroDEP ][52]
[ All Technologies ][53]

## Who We Are

ARx specializes in developing novel, innovative drug delivery systems that improve control of drug
release and absorption, bioavailability, as well as patient experience and safety, expanding
therapeutic potential and redefining what’s possible for patients. As one of the first pioneers in
film and adhesive polymer science and novel dosing strategies, we’ve helped shape modern drug
delivery through higher standards for quality, safety and efficacy.

[ ABOUT ARx ][54]

## Product Development & Commercialization

ARx supports every stage of the drug development lifecycle. From formulation to commercial
manufacturing, we expedite timelines and improve patient outcomes with an eye for optimizing safety
and effectiveness.

**Process Development**

We accelerate filing and commercialization processes with scalable manufacturing. Using QbD
principles, we optimize production with yields and regulatory approval in mind.

**Commercial Manufacturing**

ARx produces over 100 million units annually in FDA-registered cGMP facilities. We guarantee a
reliable supply of high-quality films and patches from launch through ongoing production.

**Quality Management**

Quality comes first. At ARx, we prioritize transparency and QC, ensuring compliance at each stage in
your development process.

**Analytical Testing**

Every ARx product is driven by advancing patient health. We thoroughly test formulations on-site to
ensure they meet product specifications and the highest clinical standards.

**Product Development**

ARx is driven by collaboration. We work hand-in-hand with partners to design, develop and bring
life-changing products to market and fulfill subsequent demand.

[ EXPLORE ARx SERVICES ][55]

## Therapeutic Areas

Patients with complex conditions need drug delivery systems that are precise, customized, and
adaptable. Standard methods often fail to provide consistent dosing, improved absorption, and
sustained effects. ARx designs tailored delivery systems that improve drug bioavailability while
avoiding first-pass metabolism and accommodating complex conditions to improve patient quality of
life.

Our solutions cover the following therapeutic areas:
* Parkinson's
* Alzheimer’s
* Cancer
* Opioid Addiction
* Chronic Pain
* Obesity

### Parkinson's Disease

Controlled-release systems provide reliable, consistent dosing, helping patients manage Parkinson's
disease more effectively while supporting better adherence and quality of life.

### Alzheimer’s Disease

Alternative delivery methods ensure steady absorption and consistent dosing, supporting long-term
management of Alzheimer’s disease and cognitive function.

### Cancer

Controlled, consistent drug delivery reduces dosing frequency and side effects, improving comfort
for cancer patients throughout treatment.

### Opioid Addiction

Alternative dosing systems enhance adherence and provide steady medication delivery, supporting
recovery and reducing the risk of relapse.

### Chronic Pain

Transdermal patches and oral thin films provide reliable pain relief, reducing dosing frequency and
minimizing side effects, making chronic pain management more manageable.

### Obesity

Oral thin films and transdermal patches offer discreet, easy-to-use delivery options, helping
patients with obesity manage their treatment and improve adherence.

# Transdermal
# **Drug Delivery Systems**

[Home]
About US

### MTC-Y™
### Semi-Solid Carrier

## Biotts is a biotech company specializing in **Transdermal Drug Delivery**

Our proprietary **Multifunctional Transdermal Carrier Y (MTC-Y™)** technology allows for the
transdermal delivery of both lipophilic and hydrophilic molecules, that are much larger in size than
traditional transdermal technologies, like peptides and proteins (up to 6000 Da. so far). This opens
a whole new window of opportunity to the pharmaceutical industry and their patients to get the
benefits from transdermal drug delivery like needle-free administration, sustained dosage, and
increased bioavailability with a wide range of active ingredients.

**Biotts develop its own transdermal drug products and make their expertise and technology available
to the pharmaceutical industry through technical development collaborations.**

Transdermal drug delivery

## **Pushing the limits**
## Biotts is making
## Transdermal Drug Delivery:

a viable** alternative **to oral
drugs and injectables

a benefit to improve
**the quality of life **
for millions of patients

Transdermal drug delivery
Transdermal drug delivery

## Traditional
## **transdermal limitations**

Transdermal Drug Delivery has traditionally been limited by the skin’s tough and lipid rich outer
layer known as the stratum corneum thus rendering the skin impermeable to most biopharmaceuticals;
of the thousands of drugs currently approved by the FDA less than 30 are approved for transdermal
delivery. So far, successful transdermal drug delivery has only been accomplished with small
molecules (< 500 Da.) that are moderately lipophilic.

## Enhanced drug delivery
## with **MTC-Y™**

**The development of Biotts’ proprietary MTC-Y™ technology has effectively removed these
limitations, without the use of complicated devices or invasive technologies.**

The MTC-Y™ carrier system is a semisolid emulsion that stimulates the transportation through the
skin and can carry both lipophilic and hydrophilic molecules of up to 6,000 Da. such as peptides and
proteins into the bloodstream. MTC-Y™ allows drugs to quickly penetrate the skin without irritating
it.

[The Technology][10]

## **Improving**
## patient outcomes

**Biotts’ MTC-Y™ technology completely changes what is possible with Transdermal Drug Delivery,
making it a much more feasible alternative. **

It offers the fast onset of action of an injectable, but at more constant drug levels and in a way
that is much less invasive. Furthermore, it allows for reduced administration frequency and
increased self-administration, and with that improved quality of life for patients. It also offers
the convenience of an oral pill, but with a much more controlled and sustained release profile,
improved bioavailability, and dramatically reduced side-effects. The results are a significantly
improved performance compared to existing transdermal and topical products, and unlimited
opportunities for new transdermal product development.

# Driving partner success with reliable, expert-driven CDMO services

At Bora Pharmaceuticals, it is our shared responsibility to execute every drug program reliably on
time, consistently in full.

[ Get in touch today ][54]

## A global pharmaceutical manufacturing partner
* From sites in North America and Asia, Bora delivers reliable, high-quality drug products to 100+
  markets around the globe

Bora Pharmaceuticals is a global contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO)
specializing in formulation development, clinical and commercial cGMP manufacturing, and packaging
of complex oral solid dose, liquid, semi-solid, biologic, and sterile injectable pharmaceutical
products.

From our nine cGMP facilities across three countries, Bora Pharmaceuticals delivers drug products
with unparalleled quality to more than 100 markets around the world. Bora’s teams, technologies, and
facilities work seamlessly together with a shared commitment to supporting partners, minimizing
risk, and helping ensure therapies reach patients worldwide.

Working for a Safer Drug Supply Chain

The Bulk Pharmaceuticals Task Force (BPTF) is an industry trade organization representing
manufacturers of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), intermediates and excipients. BPTF
addresses regulatory and quality issues related to current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP)
compliance. 

 

 

[Prescription Drugs]
[[Bar Chart]][11]
[[FDA-White-Oak-Building-01.jpg]][12]
[[Business Brainstorm]][13]

Quality Performance

BPTF is focused on quality throughout the supply chain. Creating a quality culture in manufacturing
requires dilligence and a need to keep informed and aware of ever-changing regulatory guidance
and industry standards.

 

Engaged

BPTF is a key stakeholder in negotiations with FDA on authorization of the Generic Drug User Fee
Amendments (GDUFA) and works with an array of industry trade groups to stay abreast of all
developments in the drug industry.

Advocacy

BPTF is a trusted industry voice respected within the drug supply chain and trusted by influential
leaders working on supply chain safety.

Working for a Safer Drug Supply Chain

The Bulk Pharmaceuticals Task Force (BPTF) is an industry trade organization representing
manufacturers of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), intermediates and excipients. BPTF
addresses regulatory and quality issues related to current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP)
compliance. 

 

 

[Prescription Drugs]
[[Bar Chart]][11]
[[FDA-White-Oak-Building-01.jpg]][12]
[[Business Brainstorm]][13]

Quality Performance

BPTF is focused on quality throughout the supply chain. Creating a quality culture in manufacturing
requires dilligence and a need to keep informed and aware of ever-changing regulatory guidance
and industry standards.

 

Engaged

BPTF is a key stakeholder in negotiations with FDA on authorization of the Generic Drug User Fee
Amendments (GDUFA) and works with an array of industry trade groups to stay abreast of all
developments in the drug industry.

Advocacy

BPTF is a trusted industry voice respected within the drug supply chain and trusted by influential
leaders working on supply chain safety.

### CARBOGEN AMCIS Commissions Ground-Mounted Pho-tovoltaic Plant at Its Hunzenschwil Site

CARBOGEN AMCIS, a Switzerland-based pharmaceutical process development and Active Pharmaceutical
Ingredient (API) manufacturing company, has suc-cessfully commissioned a new ground-mounted
photovoltaic system at its Hunzenschwil site in Switzerland. With this project, the company
underscores its long-term commitment to sustainability and the expansion of renewable energy.
[Read more][289]

China’s NMPA confirms robust GMP compliance at CARBOGEN AMCIS Shanghai, with no observations
identified following an on-site unannounced inspection.

## A Powerful Natural Biopolymer for Health and the Environment

Chitosan is a naturally derived biopolymer with a unique positive ionic charge. This property
enables it to interact with negatively charged substances, including microbes, dietary fats,
microplastics, toxins and heavy metals.

**Natural Origin** Produced from chitin found in shellfish, mushrooms and insects.
**Positive Ionic Charge** Supports binding, antimicrobial and purification applications.
**Versatile Applications** Used across health, nutrition, agriculture, water treatment and advanced
materials.
[Chitosan applications for gut health, weight management and metabolic support][Chitosan
applications for gut health, weight management and metabolic support]
Health & Metabolic Applications
01
The Science

### What Makes Chitosan Different?

**Chitosan** is a natural substance and a **biopolymer** derived from chitin. Chitin is the second
most abundant natural material after cellulose. It is a structural sugar found in shellfish shells,
insect exoskeletons, fungi and certain algae.

Unlike most naturally occurring sugars, chitosan can carry a **positive charge**. Many pathogens,
microplastics, dietary fats, heavy metals and other unwanted compounds are negatively charged.

+

This electrostatic difference allows chitosan to attract, bind or interact with many negatively
charged substances across biological and environmental systems.

This makes chitosan particularly valuable in antimicrobial systems, digestive-health formulations,
toxin-binding applications, water purification, agriculture and advanced biomedical materials.

Functional Benefits

### How Chitosan Supports Health and Purification

Chitosan's polymer structure and ionic activity make it useful in several important health,
nutritional and environmental applications.

01

#### Dietary Fiber Support

Chitosan may serve as a natural dietary fiber ingredient that supports digestive-health and gut
microbiome formulations for humans and animals.

Digestive Health
02

#### Toxin Binding

Its polymer structure enables chitosan powder to interact with toxins and other unwanted compounds
within digestive and purification systems.

Binding Technology
03

#### Heavy Metal Removal

Chitosan can interact with negatively charged metals, including lead, arsenic, mercury and cadmium,
making it valuable in environmental purification.

Environmental Protection
04

#### Microplastic Management

Chitosan-based flocculants and binding systems are being evaluated for microplastic capture, water
clarification and advanced filtration applications.

Water Treatment
Formulation Insight

### Water-Soluble Chitosan for Modern Applications

Ultra-low molecular weight, high degree of deacetylation chitosan hydrochloride offers improved
solubility and is widely considered for food, animal-feed, nutraceutical and digestive-health
formulations.

Its positive ionic charge may support interactions with negatively charged compounds such as dietary
fats, microplastics and selected toxins.

High DDA **Up to 98%**
Molecular Weight **Controlled Grades**
Solubility **Water-Soluble Options**
Quality Matters

#### Reliable performance begins with controlled specifications.
* Consistent purity
* Controlled degree of deacetylation
* Defined molecular weight
* Reliable source and origin
* Application-specific grades

Broad Application Potential

### One Biopolymer, Multiple Industries

Beyond nutritional applications, chitosan is used and studied across biomedical, agricultural, food,
environmental and cosmetic systems.

01

#### Drug Delivery

Chitosan nanoparticles and delivery systems for pharmaceutical and biomedical research.

02

#### Wound Care

Hemostatic dressings, wound-management materials and advanced biomaterial systems.

03

#### Food Preservation

Edible coatings, freshness-support applications and moisture-management technologies.

04

#### Agriculture

Plant protection, seed treatment, crop-support and biostimulant formulations.

05

#### Water Treatment

Flocculation, filtration, heavy-metal binding and microplastic-management applications.

06

#### Cosmetics

Hair care, skin care, film-forming and personal-care formulation applications.

for manufacturers, formulators and research organizations.

We provide low molecular weight chitosan from fungal, insect and shellfish origins, along with
derivatives such as carboxymethyl chitosan, chitosan oligosaccharide and water-soluble chitosan
salts.

Natural • Positively Charged • Multifunctional

## A Powerful Natural Biopolymer for Health and the Environment

Chitosan is a naturally derived biopolymer with a unique positive ionic charge. This property
enables it to interact with negatively charged substances, including microbes, dietary fats,
microplastics, toxins and heavy metals.

**Natural Origin** Produced from chitin found in shellfish, mushrooms and insects.
**Positive Ionic Charge** Supports binding, antimicrobial and purification applications.
**Versatile Applications** Used across health, nutrition, agriculture, water treatment and advanced
materials.
[Chitosan applications for gut health, weight management and metabolic support][Chitosan
applications for gut health, weight management and metabolic support]
Health & Metabolic Applications
01
The Science

### What Makes Chitosan Different?

**Chitosan** is a natural substance and a **biopolymer** derived from chitin. Chitin is the second
most abundant natural material after cellulose. It is a structural sugar found in shellfish shells,
insect exoskeletons, fungi and certain algae.

Unlike most naturally occurring sugars, chitosan can carry a **positive charge**. Many pathogens,
microplastics, dietary fats, heavy metals and other unwanted compounds are negatively charged.

+

This electrostatic difference allows chitosan to attract, bind or interact with many negatively
charged substances across biological and environmental systems.

This makes chitosan particularly valuable in antimicrobial systems, digestive-health formulations,
toxin-binding applications, water purification, agriculture and advanced biomedical materials.

Functional Benefits

### How Chitosan Supports Health and Purification

Chitosan's polymer structure and ionic activity make it useful in several important health,
nutritional and environmental applications.

01

#### Dietary Fiber Support

Chitosan may serve as a natural dietary fiber ingredient that supports digestive-health and gut
microbiome formulations for humans and animals.

Digestive Health
02

#### Toxin Binding

Its polymer structure enables chitosan powder to interact with toxins and other unwanted compounds
within digestive and purification systems.

Binding Technology
03

#### Heavy Metal Removal

Chitosan can interact with negatively charged metals, including lead, arsenic, mercury and cadmium,
making it valuable in environmental purification.

Environmental Protection
04

#### Microplastic Management

Chitosan-based flocculants and binding systems are being evaluated for microplastic capture, water
clarification and advanced filtration applications.

Water Treatment
Formulation Insight

### Water-Soluble Chitosan for Modern Applications

Ultra-low molecular weight, high degree of deacetylation chitosan hydrochloride offers improved
solubility and is widely considered for food, animal-feed, nutraceutical and digestive-health
formulations.

Its positive ionic charge may support interactions with negatively charged compounds such as dietary
fats, microplastics and selected toxins.

High DDA **Up to 98%**
Molecular Weight **Controlled Grades**
Solubility **Water-Soluble Options**
Quality Matters

#### Reliable performance begins with controlled specifications.
* Consistent purity
* Controlled degree of deacetylation
* Defined molecular weight
* Reliable source and origin
* Application-specific grades

Broad Application Potential

### One Biopolymer, Multiple Industries

Beyond nutritional applications, chitosan is used and studied across biomedical, agricultural, food,
environmental and cosmetic systems.

01

#### Drug Delivery

Chitosan nanoparticles and delivery systems for pharmaceutical and biomedical research.

02

#### Wound Care

Hemostatic dressings, wound-management materials and advanced biomaterial systems.

03

#### Food Preservation

Edible coatings, freshness-support applications and moisture-management technologies.

04

#### Agriculture

Plant protection, seed treatment, crop-support and biostimulant formulations.

05

#### Water Treatment

Flocculation, filtration, heavy-metal binding and microplastic-management applications.

06

#### Cosmetics

Hair care, skin care, film-forming and personal-care formulation applications.

Chitosan Global

### Characterized Materials for Research, Formulation and Manufacturing

Our insect-derived and fungal chitosans provide clean, sustainable and reproducible sourcing options
for manufacturers, formulators and research organizations.

We provide low molecular weight chitosan from fungal, insect and shellfish origins, along with
derivatives such as carboxymethyl chitosan, chitosan oligosaccharide and water-soluble chitosan
salts.

international, family-owned business built on quality, reliability and long-term partnerships.

The manufacturers constantly refine the ingredients. The producers constantly refine the products.
We pay respect to both by constantly refining the distribution.

Premium quality vitamins, minerals and proteins.
Developed by handpicked manufacturers.
And carefully distributed to the food industry.

### PHARMA

something as simple as being reliable.

Data Insights Market is one of the leading providers of syndicated and customized research reports,
consulting services, and analytical information on markets and companies across the world. Data
Insights Market partners with clients in many countries and industry verticals such as A & D,
Chemical & material, Energy Power, F & B, Retail, Healthcare and many more to provide high value

Since its inception, Data Insights Market has continued to innovate, increased its product and
service portfolio, and remained focused on the needs of its clients to root out poor-quality data
and establish itself as a winning partner for businesses. DIM has a legacy of serving and
facilitating clients from all over the world and played a vital role in their success story. Our
clients include many types of organizations, the majority of which are Fortune 500 companies.

The 360-degree research methodology requires us to only dispense facilities based on our unique data
model so that the authenticity and integrity of the services are maintained. This methodology makes
sure that the analysis is comprehensive and accurate. We can provide services of importance to our
clients well within the time limit by keeping a close eye on relevant press releases, official
publications, decades of trade data, technical and white papers. We also offer services based on the
following: We use a variety of new, useful approaches to big data and the tools of qualitative and
quantitative marketing research to understand clients properly. The key objectives are to examine
niche markets, outline the main drivers, and indicate the most hazardous obstacles. We track major
local and global trends in this field and strive to balance the quality level within a given time

## They're slow. They're expensive.

01
They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself

reading of the same primary sources — with their biases baked in.

"Analysts add interpretation. Not always accuracy."
02
By the time it lands, it's old.

Drug markets move fast. A competitor files an ANDA. A court issues an injunction. A biosimilar gets
the nod. These things happen on a Tuesday.

**Your quarterly report arrives on a Thursday — three months later.** You've already missed the
window. The early-mover advantage went to whoever was watching the primary data in real time. Not
waiting for someone to write it up nicely.

contract ends.** The data is theirs. The methodology is theirs. If you want to ask a different

## WHY CHOOSE US

At the nexus of trust and tradition, we are not just your generic pharmaceutical distributors, but

#### Valuable Industry Experience

Your business deserves expert guidance, and our sales representatives bring unmatched industry
expertise of 30+ years to the table. They manage your account while ensuring you receive tailored

industry.


#### 2000+ SKUs

As seasoned generic pharmaceutical distributors, our vast inventory includes over 2,000 SKUs,
allowing us to supply a comprehensive range of pharmaceutical formulations to support your
pharmacy’s operational requirements. From widely used generics to specialized therapies, our
exhaustive portfolio keeps your shelves stocked and compliant.


#### Vast Distribution Network in 50 States

With our extensive nationwide distribution network and license to operate in all 50 states, we
ensure timely and compliant deliveries, reducing wait times and helping you maintain optimal
inventory levels. Our logistical capabilities mean we are always ready to ship directly to your
establishment.


#### Best Pricing in the Industry

Our commitment to affordability is unwavering. We leverage long-standing manufacturer partnerships
and bulk procurement strength to deliver competitive pricing at scale. Every purchase aligns with
our promise of compliance, reliability, and consistent quality—helping healthcare providers maintain
cost efficiency without compromise.


#### Commitment to Innovation

By investing in advanced technology, Drugzone streamlines ordering, tracking, and compliance.
Healthcare partners—from specialty clinics to hospital chains—benefit from secure, efficient, and
transparent operations. Our integrated ERP and compliance monitoring systems enhance real-time
visibility, inventory accuracy, and traceability throughout the supply chain.


#### Partner-Centric Approach

Long-term relationships drive our success. Drugzone works closely with hospitals, LTC providers, and
specialty networks—listening to their needs and delivering solutions that help them serve their
patients better. Our dedicated account managers provide personalized support, ensuring every partner
experiences responsive communication, consistent supply, and measurable value from our
collaboration.

## Comprehensive Distribution Capabilities

Drugzone combines industry expertise with strong logistics to provide comprehensive generic
distribution services. Each capability is designed to help healthcare and specialty partners
maintain a safe, seamless, and cost-effective supply chain.

### Wholesale& Specialty Distribution

Reliable, nationwide generic pharmaceutical supply for healthcare and specialty care providers
across the U.S. Our consistent processes make us a trusted choice among wholesale pharmaceutical
distributors in the U.S.

### Logistics& Warehousing

State-of-the-art warehouses and a nationwide delivery network ensure secure storage and timely
shipments, reducing inventory gaps for healthcare networks nationwide.

### Provider& Pharmacy Solutions

Tailored support for diverse healthcare partners and specialty distributors to simplify procurement
and maintain an uninterrupted treatment supply.

### Compliance& Quality Assurance

We ensure full adherence to NABP, FDA, and DSCSA 2025 guidelines. Every shipment undergoes stringent
checks to ensure healthcare providers—across human and animal health—receive authentic and traceable
products.

Strategic Manufacturer Partnerships

## Mission & Vision

[img]

### Mission

To advance healthcare delivery by ensuring access to safe, effective, and affordable generic
pharmaceuticals through innovation, compliance, and service excellence. Drugzone is committed to
empowering healthcare providers—hospitals, long-term care facilities, specialty clinics, and
veterinary networks—through transparent operations, ethical sourcing, and nationwide reliability.
* **Our mission focuses on:**
* Ensuring secure, compliant, and traceable pharmaceutical distribution across all 50 states.
* Maintaining ethical and transparent partnerships with healthcare providers and manufacturers.
* Promoting innovation in logistics, compliance, and digital fulfillment for greater efficiency.
* Upholding regulatory integrity through NABP, FDA, and DSCSA 2025 compliance.
* Creating long-term value by prioritizing patient safety and partner trust.

[img]

### Vision

To be among the nation’s most trusted pharmaceutical distribution companies, defined by integrity,
professionalism, and continuous innovation. Drugzone envisions a future where compliant and
affordable access to quality pharmaceuticals strengthens the entire continuum of care.
* **Our vision aspires to:**
* Lead the U.S. market as a benchmark in generic pharmaceutical distribution.
* Advance technology-driven operations that enhance fulfillment speed and traceability.
* Build sustainable business practices that support healthcare accessibility nationwide.
* Foster a partner-first culture rooted in transparency and responsiveness.
* Continue setting new standards of reliability and trust across human and animal health sectors.

## Licensed in All 50 States

With FDA registration and DSCSA 2025 readiness, our 50-state licensing ensures healthcare providers
across the U.S. receive authentic, safe, and timely pharmaceutical supply.
