## Frequently Asked Question

### 1. What does Farbe Firma specialize in manufacturing?

We are a specialized pharmaceutical formulation manufacturer focusing on Critical Care Injectables.
Our capabilities include liquid ampoules, sterile vials, Lyophilized (Freeze-Dried) injections, and
lipid emulsions across therapeutic areas like Anaesthesia, Pain Management, and Anti-infectives.


### 2. Are your manufacturing facilities WHO-GMP certified?

Yes, our manufacturing facility in Ankleshwar, Gujarat, is WHO-GMP certified. We adhere strictly to
global pharmacopeial standards (USP/BP/IP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) to ensure the
highest sterility and quality for international markets.


### 3. Do you offer Contract Manufacturing (CMO) and CDMO services?

Yes, we provide comprehensive Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) services.
We support global pharmaceutical companies with formulation development, private label
manufacturing, and scale-up of sterile injectables under their own brand names.


### 4. Which countries do you currently export to?

Farbe Firma exports to over 30 countries across Latin America, Africa, CIS, Southeast Asia, and the
Middle East. We have a dedicated export department that manages logistics and supply chain
compliance for global partners.


### 5. Do you provide Regulatory Dossiers and registration support?

Absolutely. We support our partners with complete regulatory documentation, including Dossiers
(CTD/ACTD formats), Certificates of Analysis (COA), and Stability Data to facilitate smooth product
registration in your local market.


### 6. How can I request a price quote or product sample?

For bulk inquiries, contract manufacturing proposals, or sample requests, please contact our export
team directly at [director@farbefirma.org][57] or via WhatsApp at +91 932 797 4224.

## Frequently Asked Question

### 1. What does Farbe Firma specialize in manufacturing?

We are a specialized pharmaceutical formulation manufacturer focusing on Critical Care Injectables.
Our capabilities include liquid ampoules, sterile vials, Lyophilized (Freeze-Dried) injections, and
lipid emulsions across therapeutic areas like Anaesthesia, Pain Management, and Anti-infectives.


### 2. Are your manufacturing facilities WHO-GMP certified?

Yes, our manufacturing facility in Ankleshwar, Gujarat, is WHO-GMP certified. We adhere strictly to
global pharmacopeial standards (USP/BP/IP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) to ensure the
highest sterility and quality for international markets.


### 3. Do you offer Contract Manufacturing (CMO) and CDMO services?

Yes, we provide comprehensive Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) services.
We support global pharmaceutical companies with formulation development, private label
manufacturing, and scale-up of sterile injectables under their own brand names.


### 4. Which countries do you currently export to?

Farbe Firma exports to over 30 countries across Latin America, Africa, CIS, Southeast Asia, and the
Middle East. We have a dedicated export department that manages logistics and supply chain
compliance for global partners.


### 5. Do you provide Regulatory Dossiers and registration support?

Absolutely. We support our partners with complete regulatory documentation, including Dossiers
(CTD/ACTD formats), Certificates of Analysis (COA), and Stability Data to facilitate smooth product
registration in your local market.


### 6. How can I request a price quote or product sample?

For bulk inquiries, contract manufacturing proposals, or sample requests, please contact our export
team directly at [director@farbefirma.org][57] or via WhatsApp at +91 932 797 4224.

About Us

# A better world with photonics

G&H delivers advanced photonics engineering and manufacturing solutions for industrial, telecoms,
aerospace, defense, space, quantum, and life sciences applications.

[Find Out More][60]Explore
[A technician in a cleanroom gown, hair net, and safety glasses uses a microscope to inspect a
precision optical component on a metal fixture in a laboratory setting.]
Solutions

## Enabling **market solutions** for core applications

We focus our photonics expertise in designing, engineering and manufacturing to provide our OEM
customers with the solutions they need. Whatever the application or environment, we can work with
you to enable greater system efficiency and effectiveness.

[

### Aerospace and Defense

In harsh aerospace and defense environments there are no second chances. Mission-critical technology
demands uncompromising precision, absolute reliability, and close partnerships with suppliers.

Find out more
][61]
[

### Industrial and Telecom

Photonics technology is crucial in many fields, from laser based manufacturing to subsea
communication to energy infrastructure. Optimum performance relies on solutions of the highest
quality, reliability and durability.

Find out more
][62]
[

### Life Sciences

As medical innovation accelerates so do the demands on technology. Our solutions for life sciences
are enabling developments in diagnostic, analytic, surgical, therapeutic and drug delivery devices.

Find out more
][63]
Our Business

## G&H our business

Watch our video to discover how our people, photonics technologies and global manufacturing
capabilities support customers across Industrial, Aerospace & Defence, and Life Sciences markets.

[Watch now][64]
Products

## Explore our extensive **product** range

The G&H photonics products range includes acousto, electro, fiber and precision optic technologies.
Over 70 years’ experience, unique expertise, world-class facilities and a commitment to working in
partnership, enable us to deliver the highest quality components and optical systems.

[View All Products][65]
[

### Acousto-Optics

Unmatched optical power handling and optical performance. Delivered consistently over time and in
volume.

Find out more][66]
[

### Crystal Optics

High-optical throughput and precise phase control. A wide selection of homegrown crystal boules and
materials are available.

Find out more][67]
[

### Electro-Optics

Minimized drive voltages and high pulse rate operation. Complete and customised system designs.

Find out more][68]
[

### Fiber Optics

G&H fiber optics, optimal performance and reliability. Qualified and deployed in many harsh
environments.

Find out more][69]
[

### Precision Optics

Precision optical components for applications that require high-quality custom optics.

Find out more][70]
[

### Polymer Optics

Polymer Optics lightweight, cost-effective, precision-molded optical solutions for diverse
applications worldwide.

Find out more][71]
[

### Optical Coatings & Filters

High-performance optical coatings and filters engineered to enhance transmission, reflection, and
durability.

Find out more][72]
[

### Lens Systems

Unique cutting-edge optical solutions and lens assemblies for a diverse customer base and a
staggering range of applications.

Find out more][73]
[

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

Innovation Fuels Breakthroughs Breakthroughs Unlock Possibilities Possibilities Enhance Lives

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

Innovation Fuels Breakthroughs Breakthroughs Unlock Possibilities Possibilities Enhance Lives

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform completely free, browse,
build a profile, send introduction requests. Manufacturers can claim their listing and receive
requests for free too. We plan to offer optional paid features for manufacturers who want promoted
placement and advanced reach, but the core marketplace stays free for both sides.

Who can see my contact details and company information?

Your direct contact information, email, phone, address, is never shown publicly. It's only shared
with a specific counterpart after both sides agree to the introduction. Your company profile (name,
location, categories, description) is public and helps the right partners find you.

How quickly can I realistically expect a first connection?

Distributors with a complete profile and a clear target category typically hear back within a few
days of sending their first request. Manufacturers with detailed profiles and active distribution
offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both
sides, we notify immediately by email so nothing sits unseen.

Can I use the platform in my own language?

Yes. The interface is available in 17 languages, use the language switcher on any page. In your
dashboard you can write your profile, offers and product descriptions in your own language and
translate them to English in one click. Catalog content is also shown machine-translated in several
major languages.

## Two sides publish. Hell of a Partner matches.

A brand posts the distribution it needs. A distributor posts the capability it offers. Hell of a

### Hell of a Partner, the platform

It scores every distributor against each brand's offer on seven weighted criteria, then brokers the
introduction. Contact details stay private until the request is accepted.

What makes it different

## Local and craft makers you won't find on the big networks

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around the small producers the transnational
marketplaces never list: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops, cooperatives and
family farms. Each is checked against an official government registry or a recognized origin mark,
and sorted by category and country, so you can actually find and trust them.

[Browse the catalog by category and country →][8]
* Verified at the source
  
  Matched to official business registries (SIREN, CVR, RCCM and dozens more) or protected origin
  marks like PDO, GI and Genuine Jersey, not a self-declared badge.
* Sorted by category and country
  
  Find a specific product in a specific market instead of scrolling an endless, unfiltered list.
* Reachable even without a website
  
  Small makers surfaced through public registries and social profiles, with the source of every
  listing shown so you can check it yourself.

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform completely free, browse,
build a profile, send introduction requests. Manufacturers can claim their listing and receive
requests for free too. We plan to offer optional paid features for manufacturers who want promoted
placement and advanced reach, but the core marketplace stays free for both sides.

Who can see my contact details and company information?

Your direct contact information, email, phone, address, is never shown publicly. It's only shared
with a specific counterpart after both sides agree to the introduction. Your company profile (name,
location, categories, description) is public and helps the right partners find you.

How quickly can I realistically expect a first connection?

Distributors with a complete profile and a clear target category typically hear back within a few
days of sending their first request. Manufacturers with detailed profiles and active distribution
offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both
sides, we notify immediately by email so nothing sits unseen.

Can I use the platform in my own language?

Yes. The interface is available in 17 languages, use the language switcher on any page. In your
dashboard you can write your profile, offers and product descriptions in your own language and
translate them to English in one click. Catalog content is also shown machine-translated in several
major languages.

International Journal for Research in Applied Science and Engineering Technology (IJRASET) is open
access, multidisciplinary engineering, technology and science peer-reviewed publication journal that
publishes original studies and review papers from all major engineering, science and technology
divisions.

IJRASET does not charge for access to more than 35000 published papers to subscribers or their
institutions. Open access gives users the ability to read, view, copy, share, publish, browse or
link to the full text of these documents, provided that they are correctly recognized and
referenced.

For all fields pertaining to applied sciences, engineering and technology, we approve research
papers or review papers. At IJRASET, we delegate each article to DOI by crossref to help writers get
more exposure and quotes. We are also linked to the world's leading association for developing
science promotion work, which will also help writers achieve more internet exposure.

IJRASET specifically meets UGC Care, AICTE, SCI, WoS, Scopus Journal Reputation Enhancement
Criteria, ranking, acceptance, and potential recognition. As per UGC Care guidelines, our plagiarism
policy is established. We have a strong and reputable team of reviewers from different nations, such
as India, China, the USA, the UK, Canada, etc.

Why Inspire

## Specialty supply is a clinical decision — we treat it that way.

Specialty medicines aren't ordinary stock. A delayed oncology cycle, a missed dialysis session, an
ICU drug that didn't make it through customs — each one shows up in patient outcomes.

Inspire was built to remove those failures from the supply side. We focus narrowly on four specialty
areas, we keep the same molecules in stock month after month, and we are accountable for the chain
from manufacturer to hospital pharmacy.

[More about Inspire][20]
What we do for clinicians and procurement

## Registered. Sourced. Delivered — to clinical specification.

We are organised around what hospital pharmacy, oncology day-care units, dialysis centres and tender
boards actually need: a known supplier, a registered product, and dependable lead time.

### Scientific office support

Our in-house medical team works directly with prescribers — protocol fit, mechanism of action,
contraindications and SmPC documentation. Specialty supply backed by clinical understanding, not
just a sales call.

### Cold-chain reliability

Biologics, plasma-derived therapies and selected oncology agents are handled with
temperature-controlled logistics, transit monitoring and conditioned warehousing — verified at
hospital goods-in.

### Hospital & tender supply

Direct supply to private & public hospitals, oncology day-care units, dialysis providers, and county
/ national pharmaceutical tenders.

[Full capabilities][21]
Built around the prescriber

## The people who choose the medicine are the people we work for.

Oncologists, nephrologists, hospital pharmacists, intensivists, procurement officers — these are the
audiences our scientific office, regulatory team and supply chain are designed around.

If you are one of them and you need product information, supply confirmation or a tender response,
our team is one enquiry away.

[Contact our team][22]
For healthcare professionals

## Need product information, availability or supply support?

Our scientific office responds to medical-information requests, hospital-procurement enquiries and
tender queries within one working day.

Beyond filings

## India Entry, GTM, M&A and Feasibility, backed by global research.

For global enterprises entering India, and Indian companies expanding across markets and capital.
KAMRIT runs the strategy work alongside the filings. Our sister firm Claight (same directors, same
shareholders) supplies the market intelligence, sector research, and procurement data that informs
every recommendation.

1
**India Entry & Feasibility Studies**

Pre-feasibility, market sizing, FDI route, entity selection, regulatory mapping, and 90-180-365 day
operating plan.

2
**GTM Strategy & Channel Architecture**

Six to ten week sprints ending in a binding plan: segment priorities, channel design, P&L, hiring
and regulatory checklist.

3
**M&A, Valuation & Transfer Pricing**

Buy-side and sell-side advisory, registered-valuer reports, transfer pricing studies and 3CEB
filings.

[Plan your India entry][53] [Read GTM playbook][54]
Why KAMRIT

## India's most trusted compliance partner.

15+ years of expertise. Senior-partner accountability. 100% online tracking. No hidden charges.

01

### Senior partner accountability

Every engagement is owned end to end by a partner. No layered teams, no chasing analysts.

02

### Fixed-fee transparent pricing

Published prices for every service. No surprise invoices. Monthly retainers for ongoing compliance.

03

### 100% online delivery

Track applications, documents, and due dates in one dashboard. File from anywhere in India.

04

### India-wide and global

Headquartered in Delhi and Noida, serving clients across India, plus USA, UK, Singapore, and UAE
setup.

How it works

## From enquiry to filing in four steps.

### Tell us what you need

Share a quick description of your business and the service you need. A KAMRIT expert reviews it
within one business day.

### Document review

We send you a precise document checklist. Your dedicated expert reviews everything before any portal
submission.

### Online filing

We file with MCA, GSTN, Income Tax, IPO, RBI, or the relevant authority and track every
notification.

### Approval & ongoing support

You receive your certificate, PAN, GSTIN, or registration number with full digital backup. We stay
on for ongoing compliance.

[Start your filing today][55]
Industries we serve

## Industry-specific advisory across India.

From e-commerce and SaaS to manufacturing and exports, KAMRIT supports businesses across every
industry domain.

[E-commerce & D2C][56] [SaaS & Technology][57] [Manufacturing][58] [Retail & Consumer Goods][59]
[Healthcare & Pharma][60] [Real Estate & Construction][61] [Logistics & Supply Chain][62] [Financial
Services][63] [Education & EdTech][64] [Food & Beverage][65] [Exports & Trading][66] [Agriculture &
Agritech][67] [Energy & Renewables][68] [Automotive][69] [Aerospace & Defence][70] [Media &
Entertainment][71] [Consulting & Professional Services][72]
5+ Years of professional service since 2020
12 Practice areas under one accountable team
100+ Indian and global clients served
4 Office locations: Delhi (HQ), Noida, plus partner offices

## Built for businesses that need both filings and strategy

Most businesses in India choose between two kinds of partner. Filing platforms are fast and cheap,
but they will not advise you on a market entry, a transaction, or an audit. Boutique consulting
firms are strong on strategy, but they will not file your GSTR-3B or push your DIR-3 KYC. KAMRIT
does both.

That works because KAMRIT is structured as a financial services LLP with capability across
registration, tax, audit, and corporate compliance, and it operates alongside our sister firm
Claight (same directors, same shareholders) which publishes research, analytics, and procurement
intelligence across nineteen industries. Filings flow into advisory. Advisory flows into filings.
One partner is accountable.

## What that gets you
* **Volume work without the platform cost.** Private Limited Company registration starts at ₹4,899.
  GST returns from ₹699 a month. Trademark filing at ₹4,899. All fixed fee.
* **Strategic work without the Big-Four price.** India entry, feasibility studies, GTM strategy,
  M&A, and transfer pricing engagements led by senior partners.
* **Research at your shoulder.** Claight market intelligence informs our India entry and GTM work,
  used by clients across SaaS, manufacturing, healthcare, and consumer goods.
* **A single calendar across regulators.** ROC, FEMA, RBI, GST, Income Tax, PF, ESI, Shops Act, all
  owned, filed, and reported on monthly.

Frequently asked

## Quick answers from our experts.

What services does KAMRIT offer?

KAMRIT offers the complete India advisory stack. Company registration (Private Limited, LLP, OPC,
Section 8, Producer, Nidhi), GST registration and returns, income tax and TDS, MCA and ROC
compliance, trademark and IP, payroll and labour, audit and assurance, plus India entry, GTM
strategy, M&A advisory, and FEMA / RBI work.

How is KAMRIT different from IndiaFilings or a typical CA firm?

Two ways. First, we run both the filings (like a platform) and the strategic advisory (like a
consulting firm) under one roof, so a Private Limited Company registration can flow into a GTM
strategy and an audited annual return without changing vendors. Second, KAMRIT and our sister firm
Claight share directors and shareholders, which means our India entry, market sizing, and
procurement intelligence work sits on top of the same research feeds Fortune 500 strategy and
procurement teams already use.

How much does company registration cost in India?

KAMRIT registers a Private Limited Company starting at ₹4,899, an LLP starting at ₹3,899, a One
Person Company at ₹3,899, and a Sole Proprietorship at ₹1,899. Pricing is fixed-fee and inclusive of
MCA name approval, MOA and AOA drafting, incorporation, PAN, TAN, and bank account opening
assistance.

How long does GST registration take?

A standard GST registration takes seven to ten working days from document submission, subject to the
GSTN officer's processing time. KAMRIT files within one business day of receiving complete documents
and tracks every notification end to end.

From e-commerce and SaaS to manufacturing and exports, KAMRIT supports businesses across every
industry domain.

100+ Indian and global clients served

## Built for businesses that need both filings and strategy

Most businesses in India choose between two kinds of partner. Filing platforms are fast and cheap,
but they will not advise you on a market entry, a transaction, or an audit. Boutique consulting
firms are strong on strategy, but they will not file your GSTR-3B or push your DIR-3 KYC. KAMRIT
does both.

That works because KAMRIT is structured as a financial services LLP with capability across
registration, tax, audit, and corporate compliance, and it operates alongside our sister firm
Claight (same directors, same shareholders) which publishes research, analytics, and procurement
intelligence across nineteen industries. Filings flow into advisory. Advisory flows into filings.
One partner is accountable.

## What that gets you
* **Volume work without the platform cost.** Private Limited Company registration starts at ₹4,899.
  GST returns from ₹699 a month. Trademark filing at ₹4,899. All fixed fee.
* **Strategic work without the Big-Four price.** India entry, feasibility studies, GTM strategy,
  M&A, and transfer pricing engagements led by senior partners.
* **Research at your shoulder.** Claight market intelligence informs our India entry and GTM work,
  used by clients across SaaS, manufacturing, healthcare, and consumer goods.
* **A single calendar across regulators.** ROC, FEMA, RBI, GST, Income Tax, PF, ESI, Shops Act, all
  owned, filed, and reported on monthly.

Frequently asked

## Quick answers from our experts.

What services does KAMRIT offer?

KAMRIT offers the complete India advisory stack. Company registration (Private Limited, LLP, OPC,
Section 8, Producer, Nidhi), GST registration and returns, income tax and TDS, MCA and ROC
compliance, trademark and IP, payroll and labour, audit and assurance, plus India entry, GTM
strategy, M&A advisory, and FEMA / RBI work.

How is KAMRIT different from IndiaFilings or a typical CA firm?

Two ways. First, we run both the filings (like a platform) and the strategic advisory (like a
consulting firm) under one roof, so a Private Limited Company registration can flow into a GTM
strategy and an audited annual return without changing vendors. Second, KAMRIT and our sister firm
Claight share directors and shareholders, which means our India entry, market sizing, and
procurement intelligence work sits on top of the same research feeds Fortune 500 strategy and
procurement teams already use.

How much does company registration cost in India?

KAMRIT registers a Private Limited Company starting at ₹4,899, an LLP starting at ₹3,899, a One
Person Company at ₹3,899, and a Sole Proprietorship at ₹1,899. Pricing is fixed-fee and inclusive of
MCA name approval, MOA and AOA drafting, incorporation, PAN, TAN, and bank account opening
assistance.

How long does GST registration take?

A standard GST registration takes seven to ten working days from document submission, subject to the
GSTN officer's processing time. KAMRIT files within one business day of receiving complete documents
and tracks every notification end to end.

As a carrying and forwarding agent receiving the goods from the factories, warehousing these goods,

## "Strive not to be a success, but rather to be of value!"

### Khandelwal Associates is a Pharmaceutical Logistics Company, established in the year 1989.
### Providing services to more than 700 clients since 33 years. The firm majors in four services
### which are Carrying and Forwarding Agency Consignee Agency, Distributorship and Mother Warehouse
### Facility. Infrastructure with ultra-modern IT facilities and spacious warehouses. Provision of
### generator at the warehouse for uninterrupted power supply. Cold Room Facilities are also
### available for storage.
* 1989 : Our company was incorporated as Khandelwal Associatel, established in year 1989, as a
  Pharmaceutical Company in Indore. The foundation of our enterprise were laid with a passionate
  vision and the aim to achieve unparalleled success.
* 1995 : After years of conscientious practice in Pharmaceutical Business, we became associated with
  one of the top firms in the Pharmaceutical field, Emcure Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd.
* 2003 - 2004 : We established our main head office in indore with in house facilities for
  hospitality, support, operations, cold chain facilities, material handeling and three warehouses.
  Also got associated with Zuventus Healthcare Ltd.
* 2005 : Association with Medopharm Pharmaceuticals.
* 2008 - 2011 : Collaborated with Adley Labs, Gennova Biopharmaceuticals, Cachet Pharmaceuticals
  Private Limited and Talent Healthcare.
* 2013 - 2014 : We became C&F agents for Koey Pharmaceuticals and also became Adley Mother Warehouse
  Facility.

## Services

"To give real service you must add something which cannot be bought or measured with money, and that
is sincerity and integrity."

#### Carrying & Forwarding Agent

As a carrying and forwarding agent receiving the goods from the factories, warehousing these goods,
receiving dispatch orders from the principal, and much more.

#### Consignee Agent

As a consignee agent, the company's name is reflected in the consignee column in the bill of lading
or in other words the “buyer” of the cargo.

#### Mother Warehouse Facility

A mother warehouse is a commercial building for storage of goods. Mother Warehouses are used by
exporters, wholesalers, transport businesses, etc.

#### Distributorship

It’s about getting the right medicines to the right patients at the right time, safely and
efficiently. Primary distributors sustain a complex supply chain.

# Manufacturing
# **More Tomorrows**^{TM}

**Helping you fast-track healthier futures.**

As a purpose-fueled drug delivery CDMO, we leverage our specialist injectable, inhalation and dermal
expertise to accelerate your product’s journey and make tomorrow’s possibilities a reality.

[ CDMO solutions ][45] [ Drug delivery expertise ][46]

## Innovative CDMO solutions

From development to commercial manufacturing and beyond, amplify your product’s impact with our
exceptional-by-design CDMO solutions.

[ Learn more about our solutions ][47]

## Connect with us

Our Bridgeton facility has over 155,000 sq. ft. of dedicated aseptic operations space, including
state-of-the-art laboratories and formulation suites, alongside almost 11,000 sq. ft. of fill suites
to ensure the highest levels of quality and patient safety.

[ Explore our facilities ][48] [ Explore our Bridgeton facility ][49]

## We’re hiring

Join us and become part of a CDMO dedicated to advancing our clients’ projects, ambitions and our
industry.

[
View all open vacancies ][50] [ Culture and values ][51]

Our legacy of innovation

## History of Kindeva

Since 1956, we have been developing technologies that meet the demands of today and deliver the
possibilities of tomorrow.

2024

### Developing low-GWP inhalers

Developing low-GWP inhalers and planning the opening of one of the first commercial-scale green
propellant lines for filling inhalers using propellants with up to 99.9% lower GWP than current
options.

2012

### Invented the CFC-free nasal MDI

Invented the CFC-free nasal MDI**,** a more environmentally sound device for drug delivery capable
of bypassing the blood-brain barrier.

[Analytical testing of plastic syringe for USP 661.2 compliance – Kindeva lab]

2010

### Developed the first commercially available dose counter

Developed the first commercially available dose counter, ensuring patients knew the number of
inhaler actuations remaining so they could always be prepared.

2009

### Created the TruJect™ platform

Created the TruJect™ platform and introduced the next generation of easy and reliable single-chamber
autoinjectors, widely used to deliver a variety of medications.

2005

### Solid microneedle array patch development

Solid microneedle array patch development, creating accurate, reliable intradermal delivery with the
potential to eliminate cold-chain storage and enhance immunogenicity and efficacy.

2002

### Invented the BinaJect® platform

Invented the BinaJect® platform, bringing an industry-leading dual-chamber autoinjector option to
market with enhanced stability and bioavailability.

1995

### Launched the CFC-free MDI

Launched the CFC-free MDI and set the standard for future care options developed to help safeguard
the environment.

1989

### Developed the breath-actuated inhaler

Developed the breath-actuated inhaler, a lifesaving option for individuals with hand-breath
coordination problems that make traditional inhalers difficult to use.

1970

### Launched the drug-in-adhesive patch

Launched the drug-in-adhesive patch, providing a noninvasive method for delivering a drug over an
extended timeframe.

1970

### Invented the ComboPen® platform

Invented the ComboPen® platform to deliver medical countermeasures, which fueled autoinjector
innovations for anaphylaxis.

1959

### Created the emergency use autoinjector

Created the emergency use autoinjector, laying the groundwork for the ongoing refinement of
self-administered injectables currently used by millions of people worldwide.

1956

### Invented the pressurized metered‑dose inhaler (pMDI)

Invented the pressurized metered‑dose inhaler (pMDI) and kick-started the evolution of inhaled
therapies by developing an easy-to-use device for patients around the globe.

Our legacy of innovation

## History of Kindeva

Since 1956, we have been developing technologies that meet the demands of today and deliver the
possibilities of tomorrow.

2024

### Developing low-GWP inhalers

Developing low-GWP inhalers and planning the opening of one of the first commercial-scale green
propellant lines for filling inhalers using propellants with up to 99.9% lower GWP than current
options.

2012

### Invented the CFC-free nasal MDI

Invented the CFC-free nasal MDI**,** a more environmentally sound device for drug delivery capable
of bypassing the blood-brain barrier.

[Analytical testing of plastic syringe for USP 661.2 compliance – Kindeva lab]

2010

### Developed the first commercially available dose counter

Developed the first commercially available dose counter, ensuring patients knew the number of
inhaler actuations remaining so they could always be prepared.

2009

### Created the TruJect™ platform

Created the TruJect™ platform and introduced the next generation of easy and reliable single-chamber
autoinjectors, widely used to deliver a variety of medications.

2005

### Solid microneedle array patch development

Solid microneedle array patch development, creating accurate, reliable intradermal delivery with the
potential to eliminate cold-chain storage and enhance immunogenicity and efficacy.

2002

### Invented the BinaJect® platform

Invented the BinaJect® platform, bringing an industry-leading dual-chamber autoinjector option to
market with enhanced stability and bioavailability.

1995

### Launched the CFC-free MDI

Launched the CFC-free MDI and set the standard for future care options developed to help safeguard
the environment.

1989

### Developed the breath-actuated inhaler

Developed the breath-actuated inhaler, a lifesaving option for individuals with hand-breath
coordination problems that make traditional inhalers difficult to use.

1970

### Launched the drug-in-adhesive patch

Launched the drug-in-adhesive patch, providing a noninvasive method for delivering a drug over an
extended timeframe.

1970

### Invented the ComboPen® platform

Invented the ComboPen® platform to deliver medical countermeasures, which fueled autoinjector
innovations for anaphylaxis.

1959

### Created the emergency use autoinjector

Created the emergency use autoinjector, laying the groundwork for the ongoing refinement of
self-administered injectables currently used by millions of people worldwide.

1956

### Invented the pressurized metered‑dose inhaler (pMDI)

Invented the pressurized metered‑dose inhaler (pMDI) and kick-started the evolution of inhaled
therapies by developing an easy-to-use device for patients around the globe.

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

After a successful conference of Pharmaceutica 2025, Pharma Conferences team cordially invites

Pharmaceutica 2026 covers various aspects of Bio-Pharmaceutics, [Pharmaceutical Chemistry][85], Drug

**Why you should attend?**
* Access to senior-level executives from leading international pharmaceutical & [biotechnology

* Tremendous networking opportunities to meet numerous U.S., European, Japanese and Asian biotech

* Targeted partner selections through proprietary screening process

  before looking for concrete solutions.
* Discover how advances in the sector are impacting both large and small molecule drugs.
* Explore tried and tested routes to improve [bioavailability][96].
* Understand how to develop the right formulation and delivery strategy with a strong scientific,
  clinical and commercial mind set.
* Discover the latest innovations in [drug delivery][97] devices.
* Be inspired by innovative case studies and realize the potential impact on your formulation or
  delivery processes.
* Engage in the exciting event format, with round tables, panels, showcases, speed networking and
  multiple conference tracks.
* Share experiences, insights and strategies in interactive peer to peer round tables.
* Hear more perspectives in one place – from large medium and small organizations from pharma,
  biotech and academia.
* Discover how scientific formulation advancements are being implemented in practice.

**Who Should Attend**

* Generic drugs and Biosimilars

### Sessions & Tracks


**Track 1:** [**Bio-Pharmaceutics**][98]

[Bio Pharmaceutics conferences][99] plays an important role in [drug discovery][100] like drug
disposition, Innovations in clinical development, Pharmaceutical technology, Pharmaceutics and drug
delivery, Drug design, Targeted drug, gene delivery,  [Sustained drug delivery system][101], Routes
of administration, Fundamental drug development.

**Related Associations and Societies**:  International Pharmaceutical Federation | [Pharmaceutical
Group of the European Union][102] |  [The Society of Hospital Pharmacists of
Australia][103] | Canadian Pharmacists Association | Pharmacy in China | Danish Association of
Pharmaconomists | Pharmaceutical Society of Ireland | The Pharmaceutical Association of Israel 

**Track 2: **[**Pharmaceutical Chemistry**][104]

Pharmaceutical Chemistry is the study of drug design to optimize pharmacokinetics and
pharmacodynamics, and synthesis of new drug molecules. [Pharmaceutical Chemistry][105] is a branch
of chemistry that deals with the chemical, biochemical and pharmacological aspects of drugs. It
includes synthesis/isolation, identification, structural elucidation, structural
modification, [structural activity relationship][106] (SAR) studies, and study of the chemical
characteristics, biochemical changes after drug administration and their pharmacological effects as
well as analysis of drugs. In more simple words it is more broader than [medicinal
chemistry][107] in its application also in the fields of analysis, identification, as well as,
structural elucidation of drugs.

**Related Associations and Societies**:  [Pharmaceutical Group of the European
Union][108] | International Pharmaceutical Federation | The Society of Hospital Pharmacists of
Australia |Pharmacy in China | [Danish Association of Pharmaconomists][109]

**Track 3: **[**Drug Targeting and Design**][110]

[Drug design][111], often referred to as [rational drug design][112] or simply rational design, is
the inventive process of finding new medications based on the knowledge of a biological target. The
drug is most commonly an organic small molecule that activates or inhibits the function of a
biomolecule such as a protein, which in turn results in a therapeutic benefit to the patient. In the
most basic sense, drug design involves the design of molecules that are complementary in shape and
charge to the biomolecular target with which they interact and therefore will bind to it. Drug
design frequently but not necessarily relies on computer modeling techniques. This type of modeling
is sometimes referred to as [computer-aided drug design][113]. Finally, drug design that relies on
the knowledge of the three-dimensional structure of the biomolecular target is known as
structure-based drug design. In addition to small molecules, [biopharmaceuticals][114] and
especially therapeutic antibodies are an increasingly important class of drugs and computational
methods for improving the affinity, selectivity, and stability of this protein-based therapeutics
have also been developed.

**Related Associations and Societies**:  International Pharmaceutical Federation | [Pharmaceutical
Group of the European Union][115] |  [The Society of Hospital Pharmacists of
Australia][116] | Canadian Pharmacists Association | Pharmacy in China | Danish Association of
Pharmaconomists | Pharmaceutical Society of Ireland | The Pharmaceutical Association of Israel 

**Track 4: **[**Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics in Drugs**][117]

Pharmacokinetics is currently defined as the study of the time course of drug absorption,
distribution, metabolism, and excretion. Clinical [pharmacokinetics][118] is the application of
pharmacokinetic principles to the safe and effective therapeutic management of drugs in an
individual patient. Primary goals of clinical pharmacokinetics include enhancing efficacy and
decreasing [toxicity][119] of a patient’s drug therapy. The development of strong correlations
between drug concentrations and their pharmacologic responses has enabled clinicians to apply
pharmacokinetic principles to actual patient situations.

[Pharmacodynamics][120] refers to the relationship between drug concentration at the site of action

### Sessions & Tracks


**Track 1:** [**Bio-Pharmaceutics**][98]

[Bio Pharmaceutics conferences][99] plays an important role in [drug discovery][100] like drug
disposition, Innovations in clinical development, Pharmaceutical technology, Pharmaceutics and drug
delivery, Drug design, Targeted drug, gene delivery,  [Sustained drug delivery system][101], Routes
of administration, Fundamental drug development.

**Related Associations and Societies**:  International Pharmaceutical Federation | [Pharmaceutical
Group of the European Union][102] |  [The Society of Hospital Pharmacists of
Australia][103] | Canadian Pharmacists Association | Pharmacy in China | Danish Association of
Pharmaconomists | Pharmaceutical Society of Ireland | The Pharmaceutical Association of Israel 

**Track 2: **[**Pharmaceutical Chemistry**][104]

Pharmaceutical Chemistry is the study of drug design to optimize pharmacokinetics and
pharmacodynamics, and synthesis of new drug molecules. [Pharmaceutical Chemistry][105] is a branch
of chemistry that deals with the chemical, biochemical and pharmacological aspects of drugs. It
includes synthesis/isolation, identification, structural elucidation, structural
modification, [structural activity relationship][106] (SAR) studies, and study of the chemical
characteristics, biochemical changes after drug administration and their pharmacological effects as
well as analysis of drugs. In more simple words it is more broader than [medicinal
chemistry][107] in its application also in the fields of analysis, identification, as well as,
structural elucidation of drugs.

**Related Associations and Societies**:  [Pharmaceutical Group of the European
Union][108] | International Pharmaceutical Federation | The Society of Hospital Pharmacists of
Australia |Pharmacy in China | [Danish Association of Pharmaconomists][109]

**Track 3: **[**Drug Targeting and Design**][110]

[Drug design][111], often referred to as [rational drug design][112] or simply rational design, is
the inventive process of finding new medications based on the knowledge of a biological target. The
drug is most commonly an organic small molecule that activates or inhibits the function of a
biomolecule such as a protein, which in turn results in a therapeutic benefit to the patient. In the
most basic sense, drug design involves the design of molecules that are complementary in shape and
charge to the biomolecular target with which they interact and therefore will bind to it. Drug
design frequently but not necessarily relies on computer modeling techniques. This type of modeling
is sometimes referred to as [computer-aided drug design][113]. Finally, drug design that relies on
the knowledge of the three-dimensional structure of the biomolecular target is known as
structure-based drug design. In addition to small molecules, [biopharmaceuticals][114] and
especially therapeutic antibodies are an increasingly important class of drugs and computational
methods for improving the affinity, selectivity, and stability of this protein-based therapeutics
have also been developed.

**Related Associations and Societies**:  International Pharmaceutical Federation | [Pharmaceutical
Group of the European Union][115] |  [The Society of Hospital Pharmacists of
Australia][116] | Canadian Pharmacists Association | Pharmacy in China | Danish Association of
Pharmaconomists | Pharmaceutical Society of Ireland | The Pharmaceutical Association of Israel 

**Track 4: **[**Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics in Drugs**][117]

Pharmacokinetics is currently defined as the study of the time course of drug absorption,
distribution, metabolism, and excretion. Clinical [pharmacokinetics][118] is the application of
pharmacokinetic principles to the safe and effective therapeutic management of drugs in an
individual patient. Primary goals of clinical pharmacokinetics include enhancing efficacy and
decreasing [toxicity][119] of a patient’s drug therapy. The development of strong correlations
between drug concentrations and their pharmacologic responses has enabled clinicians to apply
pharmacokinetic principles to actual patient situations.

[Pharmacodynamics][120] refers to the relationship between drug concentration at the site of action
and the resulting effect, including the time course and intensity of therapeutic and adverse
effects. The effect of a drug present at the site of action is determined by that drug’s binding
with a receptor.

Union |  [The Society of Hospital Pharmacists of Australia][1

# Innovative Transdermal Technologies and Patient-Focused Pharmaceutical Products

[FIND OUT MORE ][17]

## Nutriband Company

At Nutriband and our subsidiaries, our core focus is to use innovative drug delivery systems and
devices to improve patient outcomes, specifically targeting the Global Opioid epidemic. Fentanyl and
other opioid-based transdermal medications unfortunately play a role in a significant number of
opioid deaths each year with no solution currently available. Working with our clinical
subsidiary 4P Therapeutics, we have developed a technology called AVERSA, which we believe, with FDA
approval, will revolutionize the safety standard for these medications and save countless lives per
year.

## DEVELOPING PHARMACEUTICAL PRODUCTS

## Research & Innovation

Through our Clinical Subsidiary 4P Therapeutics, Our Company has capabilities for developing
pharmaceutical products from preclinical testing to clinical manufacturing and early-stage clinical
development (Phase I/II). A key company focus and area of expertise at 4P is in the development of
transdermal products for currently injected compounds, including proteins, peptides, macromolecules,
and biologics. Transdermal delivery of commercially available drugs or biologics that are typically
delivered by injection has the potential to improve safety, efficacy and therapeutic outcomes
associated with these treatments.

[home.jpg]

## Nutriband Subsidiaries

At Nutriband, we have two revenue-generating subsidiaries, 4P Therapeutics which focuses on clinical
research and development, and Pocono Pharmaceutical, which focuses on contract manufacturing, along
with Active Intelligence, which specializes in sports recovery products.

[home1.jpg]

4P Therapeutics is a clinical subsidiary of Nutriband Inc. (NTRB) focused on the research and
development of novel drug delivery technologies and therapeutics. 4P develops products that meet the
needs of patients, physicians and payers.

### 4P Therapeutics

[FIND OUT MORE ][26]
[home2.jpg]

Pocono Pharmaceutical is our contract manufacturing subsidiary in the area of coated materials,
Consulting, Formulations and Manufacturing.

#### Pocono Pharmaceutical

To find out more, or to enquire about our partnership options, please contact our team who can help
find the right solution for your business.

It is our goal to improve patient comfort, safety, and efficacy while setting new safety standards
for medications that are notoriously abused!

large-volume subcutaneous delivery. ][138]

history of innovation to develop an enabling technology for injectable microparticles and then
evaluating it through proof-of-principle testing. ][144]

[ INJECTION ][146]
[ Bill Welch ][147]
[PCI Pharma Services][148]

of least resistance” can reduce technical, regulatory and commercial risk, thereby optimising
product commercialisation. ][150]
[ [INJECTABLE COLLAGEN – PRESENT AND FUTURE POTENTIAL] ][151]
[ INJECTION ][152]
[ Martin Junginger ][153]
[GELITA][154]
[ INJECTABLE COLLAGEN – PRESENT AND FUTURE POTENTIAL ][155]

considering the role that collagen plays in the current healthcare landscape, including GELITA's
VACCIPRO^{®} and MEDELLAPRO^{®} collagen grades, and sharing insights on how that role may grow and
adapt going forwards. ][156]

THERAPEUTICS] ][157]

[ Dr Scott Compel ][159]
[AEMS Corp][160]

[Oncofuse][166]
[ SCALING RADIOLIGAND THERAPY: WHY PACKAGING AND DELIVERY SYSTEMS MUST EVOLVE ][167]

therapy and the imminent bottleneck presented by current delivery methods running into strict limits
on handling radioactive materials. They go on to introduce the Oncofuse prefilled-syringe-based
system as a novel approach to containment and handling of these therapies, enabling radioligand
therapy to expand beyond niche specialist clinics and hospitals. ][168]

[ CONQUERING COMPLEXITY WITH LIFECORE INJECTABLES ][172]

process development and manufacturing challenges that others avoid. This mindset is rooted in the
company’s legacy as a manufacturer of sodium hyaluronate, a highly viscous material known for being
difficult to filter and fill. ][173]

[BD (Becton Dickinson & Company)][177]

development that are designed for an optimised patient experience as well as higher-volume,
higher-viscosity delivery. ][179]

### About our parent company

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

## Frequently asked questions

What does Optimus do?
Optimus is a leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), delivering
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing of Key
Starting Materials(KSMs), Regulatory Starting Materials(RSMs), Advanced Intermediates, Drug
Substances and Drug Products to the global innovative biotech and pharmaceutical companies.
In which areas does Optimus specialise?

Optimus specialises in:
* Exclusive development and manufacturing of Late phase Molecules.
* Custom Manufacturing of KSM’s, RSMs and Advanced Intermediates.
* Backward integration of KSM’s / Intermediates
* Development and Manufacturing of Oral Solids / Semi Solids dosage forms

How does Optimus ensure quality and compliance?
Quality is maintained through stringent standards in R&D and manufacturing, supported by strong
regulatory understanding, IP management, and robust process development, validation, and
tech-transfer capabilities.
What is the scale of manufacturing capacity?
Optimus provides flexible manufacturing capacity from gram-scale to multi-tonne production,
supporting efficient and cost-effective scale-up of complex molecules and niche molecules.
Does Optimus support custom API or formulation development?
Yes. With a team of 150+ scientists and advanced facilities, Optimus offers custom process
development, analytical method validation, tech transfer, and commercial scale-up for both drug
substances and drug products.
What are the advantages of partnering with Optimus?
* 20+ years of industry expertise
* Integrated backward manufacturing offering cost advantage
* High-quality R&D for complex and niche molecules
* Global export capability and regulatory readiness
* Focus on innovation, affordability, and excellence
Can Optimus support technology transfer or process validation?
Yes. Our expertise team has extensive experience in both technology transfer from a third party
manufacturing site as well as process validations under strict quality and regulatory frameworks.
How does Optimus handle regulatory compliance and documentation?
All submissions are supported with complete documentation such as ANDA / DMFs / IMPD , technical
packages, validation reports, and CMC data to facilitate multi-market regulatory filings.
Does Optimus offer finished formulations or only APIs?
Optimus offers both drug substance and drug products developed through its dedicated formulation R&D
and manufacturing units.

# PassPort® Novel Transdermal Drug Delivery System

PassPort® Novel Transdermal Drug Delivery SystemPassPort® Novel Transdermal Drug Delivery
SystemPassPort® Novel Transdermal Drug Delivery System

**Advanced microporation technology for the delivery of therapeutics and vaccines **

[Contact Us][20]

## The PassPort® System

[Transdermal comparison to oral drug delivery]

#### Why Transdermal Drug Delivery?

 Passive transdermal drug delivery is a convenient and effective way to administer a variety of
therapeutics. This route of administration is both noninvasive and produces steady drug delivery
over an extended period of time. 



While conventional transdermal systems (such as drug patches) have demonstrated the benefits of
delivering drugs via the skin, they only work for an extremely limited number of drugs. This is
because millions of dead skin cells form a protective barrier on the surface of the skin (the
stratum corneum) that prevents most therapeutic molecules from passing into the skin. Passive
transdermal patches are typically limited to lipid-soluble drugs with a molecular weight of less
than 500 daltons.



As a result of these limitations, researchers have explored a variety of methods to penetrate this
skin barrier - ranging from chemicals to lasers, microneedles, and ultrasound. However, many of
these technologies have drawbacks or other limitations. PassPort Technologies, Inc. is looking to
overcome these challenges via a novel transdermal microporation platform called the PassPort®
system.



[PassPort System - advanced drug delivery technology]

#### PassPort® Microporation Technology

The PassPort® system is a novel active transdermal technology platform that enables efficient
delivery of small molecule drugs, peptides, proteins, carbohydrates, nucleotides, and vaccines from
a small conventional skin patch.



The patented system is designed for simple application and self-administration. Pressing the
activation button of the applicator device releases a pulse of energy to the disposable porator. The
rapid conduction of this energy into the surface of the skin painlessly ablates the stratum corneum
under each porator filament to create microchannels. A simple transdermal patch containing the
active ingredient is then applied to the ablated skin and drug delivery begins. 



[How the PassPort System works]

#### How the Technology Works

 The PassPort® technology painlessly creates aqueous micropores in the stratum corneum within a few
milliseconds. These aqueous channels enable drugs to flow from a transdermal patch, enter the viable
epidermis, and then the systemic circulation. The patch may be formulated to provide for either
immediate or sustained delivery.



PassPort Technologies is developing transdermal alternatives to invasive injection formulations…
* Better patient compliance (needle-free drug delivery)
* Convenient for patients (at-home administration)
* Improvement of storage conditions (room temperature) using a dry patch formulation
* Easy dose discontinuation by patch removal
* Economically attractive costs of goods 
* Reduces needle disposal and needlestick injuries
* Improved pharmacoeconomics (reduced healthcare costs)
* New feature: electronic medication adherence control

## Pipeline



PassPort Technologies is developing a robust internal pipeline of off-patent drugs delivered via the
novel PassPort® system. The company's lead preclinical candidate is a CNS therapeutic in development
in the US via the 505(b)(2) pathway. This candidate is available for license.



In addition, PassPort Technologies has ongoing collaborations with leading multinational
pharmaceutical companies and academic groups. Details on these pipeline PassPort® candidates are
currently undisclosed.

### About Conference



**Conference Series!!** Cordially invites participants from all over the world to
attend **“[4^{th} World Congress on Pharmaceutics, Formulations & Novel Drug Delivery
Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &
Nanotechnology, [Pharmaceutical Technology][79], Medicinal Chemistry and Drug Discovery, Novel Drug
Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

**WHO SHOULD ATTEND?**

The conference invites Directors, Group Leaders, Professors, Associate Professors, Lecturers,
Research Associates, Scientists, Investigators,  business delegates from Leading Universities,
Pharmaceutical companies, Formulation Scientists, Medical Devices, Researchers, Health care
professionals, across the globe providing a better podium, interconnecting the latest research,
technological developments in the arena as well as therapeutic aspects. Participating at [Novel Drug
Delivery][80] International conference will be an excellent opportunity to meet eminent
personalities in the fields of pharmaceutics and learn about the latest technological advancements
in Novel Drug Delivery systems.

The scientific program includes Keynote & Plenary talks, Video Presentations, [Poster
Presentations][81] and E-Posters. Furthermore, oral communications of (post)doctoral junior
scientists will be considered. It is the goal of the organizers to make this meeting an event of
scientific excellence, attractive to both industrial and academic scientists in Pharmaceutical &
Novel Drug Delivery systems of Relevant Field.

### Sessions and Tracks


**Track 1: [Pharmaceutics][82]**

[Pharmaceutics][83] are one of the primary factors for developing a [drug][84] as it involves in
converting a new chemical entity to a completely novel product which can be used for the treatment
of any disease. Pharmaceutics is one of the major components that are taken into consideration while
developing a novel drug as it primarily involves in predicting the perfect amount of dosage that is
necessary for an individual to get treated for the specific condition.

**Track 2: ****[Pharmaceutical Science and Research Advancements][85]**

[Pharmaceutical research][86] is the process through which potential new medicines are identified.
It involves a wide range of scientific disciplines, including biology, chemistry and pharmacology.
Research Drug development is the process of bringing a new pharmaceutical drug into the market once
a lead compound has been identified through the process of drug discovery. Research and development
used in developing the new series or products or improvement of existing products and services. 
* [Pharmacoepidemiology][87]
* Pharmaceutical Cell Biology
* Pharmaceutical regulatory sciences
* Recent trends in pharma technology
* Prevalance of Potential drugs

**Track 3:** **[Process Validation][88]**

[Process validation][89] is defined as the collection and evaluation of data, from
the process design stage throughout production, which establishes scientific evidence that
a process is capable of consistently delivering quality products.
* [Prospective Validation][90] This type of validation is performed before production, during a
  product's development stage
* Concurrent Validation
* Retrospective Validation
* Revalidation

**Track 4: [Drug Discovery and Development][91]**

A drug goes from being an idea in the lab to something that a doctor prescribes. To do this, it must
go through a long development and approval process. During this process, researchers make sure the
drug is safe for people to take and effectively treats cancer. This process often takes many years
and significant resources. But the actual amount of time and money needed depends on the drug.

There are 3 main steps in finding and developing a new drug:
* [Preclinical research][92], which is when the drug is found and first tested
* [Clinical research][93], which is when the drug is tested in people
* [Post-clinical research][94], which takes place after the drug is approved

**Track 5: [Novel Developments in Drug Delivery System][95]**
* Controlled Drug Delivery System
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipments

[Novel Drug delivery System][96] can be referred as, approaches, formulations, technologies, and
systems for transporting a pharmaceutical compound in the body as needed to safely achieve its
desired therapeutic effects.

In current research, Drug delivery systems has described in four broad categories:
* Routes of delivery,
* Delivery vehicles,
* Cargo
* Targeting strategies.

Drug delivery can be in a variety of ways by:
* Swallowing
* Inhalation
* Absorption through the skin
* Intravenous injection.

Drug delivery systems can be:
* [Controlled Drug Delivery System][97]
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipment’s

**Track 6: [Pharmaceutical Formulation][98]**

[Pharmaceutical formulation][99], in pharmaceutics, is the process in which different chemical
substances, including the active the drug, are combined to produce a final medicinal product. The
word formulation is often used in a way that includes dosage form.

**Track 7: [Pharmacology & Toxicology][100]**

[Pharmacology][101] is a branch of medicine or pharmaceutical sciences. It mainly deals with the
study of the body's reaction to drugs.

Interactions that occur between a living organism and chemicals that affect a normal or abnormal
biochemical function. Any substances that possess medicinal properties are considered to be
pharmaceuticals.

Sub-divisions of Pharmacology mainly include:
* Pharmacotherapeutics
* [Toxicology][102]
* Experimental pharmacology
* Clinical Pharmacology
* Chemotherapy

Toxicology studies the negative consequences of pharmaceuticals and chemical substances as well as
treatment options, while pharmacology studies the positive effects of drugs.

**Track 8: [Formulation Design and Pharmaceutical Technology][103]**

All pharmaceutical products are formulated to specific dosage forms for drugs to be effectively
delivered to patients. Typical pharmaceutical dosage forms include oral tablets, capsules,
solutions, suspensions, topical ointments, gels, and solutions, and injections for intravenous (IV),
intramuscular (IM), or subcutaneous (SC) administration. In addition, various drug delivery systems
have been developed for transdermal, intranasal, and pulmonary deliveries. Different dosage forms
require different [pharmaceutical technologies][104] and usually present different technical
challenges for formulation development.

Because of the complex technical challenges scientists encounter during formulation development, it
is important to use an effective methodology. Design of experiments and statistical analysis have
been applied widely to formulation development, and are useful in process optimization and process
validation. The major advantage of using Design of experiments to develop formulations
for [pharmaceutical products][105] is that it allows all potential factors to be evaluated
simultaneously, systematically, and quickly.

### About Conference



**Conference Series!!** Cordially invites participants from all over the world to
attend **“[4^{th} World Congress on Pharmaceutics, Formulations & Novel Drug Delivery
Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &
Nanotechnology, [Pharmaceutical Technology][79], Medicinal Chemistry and Drug Discovery, Novel Drug
Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

**WHO SHOULD ATTEND?**

The conference invites Directors, Group Leaders, Professors, Associate Professors, Lecturers,
Research Associates, Scientists, Investigators,  business delegates from Leading Universities,
Pharmaceutical companies, Formulation Scientists, Medical Devices, Researchers, Health care
professionals, across the globe providing a better podium, interconnecting the latest research,
technological developments in the arena as well as therapeutic aspects. Participating at [Novel Drug
Delivery][80] International conference will be an excellent opportunity to meet eminent
personalities in the fields of pharmaceutics and learn about the latest technological advancements
in Novel Drug Delivery systems.

The scientific program includes Keynote & Plenary talks, Video Presentations, [Poster
Presentations][81] and E-Posters. Furthermore, oral communications of (post)doctoral junior
scientists will be considered. It is the goal of the organizers to make this meeting an event of
scientific excellence, attractive to both industrial and academic scientists in Pharmaceutical &
Novel Drug Delivery systems of Relevant Field.

**Conference Benefits:**
